Following red light exposure, silent information regulation factor 4 (SIRT4) protein levels in keratinocytes were notably reduced, whereas glycolysis, fatty acid metabolism, and the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle were significantly activated in keratinocytes. The reduction in mitochondrial SIRT4 levels enhances the acetylation of mitochondrial metabolic proteins, particularly malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, a potent inhibitor of the key rate-limiting enzyme carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1A (CPT1A) in fatty acid oxidation. This process promotes mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation and the TCA cycle. Additionally, the decrease in SIRT4 activates SIRT1 through feedback mechanisms, thereby alleviating its inhibition on PPAR-α in senescent keratinocytes and comprehensively activating the expression of genes related to lipid metabolism. This lipid metabolism activation ultimately facilitates the accumulation of acetyl-CoA within keratinocytes, increases H3K9ac levels, and reshapes the expression patterns of senescence-related genes. Eventually, cellular aging is effectively mitigated by the synergistic regulation of metabolism, inflammation, and gene expression.
items.title_zh: 光调节SIRT4缓解小鼠衰老通过增强H3K9ac与脂肪酸代谢
items.summary_zh: 随着生物体的衰老，线粒体代谢活性下降，组蛋白乙酰化介导的基因表达调控失常导致组织中衰老生理表型的出现。本研究发现，周期性红光照射显著提高了衰老小鼠组织和器官中组蛋白H3赖氨酸9乙酰化（H3K9ac）水平。红光照射后，角质形成细胞中的沉默信息调节因子4（SIRT4）蛋白水平显著降低，同时糖酵解、脂肪酸代谢和三羧酸循环（TCA）在角质形成细胞中显著激活。线粒体SIRT4水平的降低增强了线粒体代谢蛋白的乙酰化，特别是马洛尼酰-CoA脱羧酶，这是一种脂肪酸氧化关键限速酶肉毒碱棕榈酰转移酶1A（CPT1A）的强抑制剂。该过程促进了线粒体脂肪酸氧化和TCA循环。此外，SIRT4的减少通过反馈机制激活SIRT1，从而减轻其对衰老角质形成细胞中PPAR-α的抑制，全面激活与脂质代谢相关基因的表达。这种脂质代谢的激活最终促进了角质形成细胞内乙酰-CoA的积累，增加了H3K9ac水平，并重塑了衰老相关基因的表达模式。
items.l1_lead: 周期性红光照射通过降低SIRT4水平，增强H3K9ac与脂肪酸代谢，从而缓解小鼠衰老现象。
items.l2_summary:
随着生物体的衰老，线粒体代谢活性下降，导致组蛋白乙酰化介导的基因表达调控失常，从而引发组织中的衰老生理表型。本研究探讨了周期性红光照射对衰老小鼠的影响，发现红光照射显著提高了衰老小鼠组织和器官中组蛋白H3赖氨酸9乙酰化（H3K9ac）水平。具体而言，红光照射后，角质形成细胞中的沉默信息调节因子4（SIRT4）蛋白水平显著降低，这一变化与糖酵解、脂肪酸代谢和三羧酸循环（TCA）的显著激活密切相关。

研究表明，线粒体SIRT4水平的降低增强了线粒体代谢蛋白的乙酰化，尤其是马洛尼酰-CoA脱羧酶，这是一种脂肪酸氧化的关键限速酶肉毒碱棕榈酰转移酶1A（CPT1A）的强抑制剂。通过这一机制，红光照射促进了线粒体脂肪酸氧化和TCA循环的活性。此外，SIRT4的减少通过反馈机制激活了SIRT1，从而减轻了其对衰老角质形成细胞中PPAR-α的抑制作用，全面激活了与脂质代谢相关基因的表达。

这种脂质代谢的激活最终导致角质形成细胞内乙酰-CoA的积累，进而增加了H3K9ac水平，并重塑了衰老相关基因的表达模式。综上所述，周期性红光照射通过调节SIRT4的表达，增强H3K9ac水平，促进脂肪酸代谢，从而有效缓解小鼠的衰老现象。这一发现为衰老相关疾病的干预提供了新的思路和潜在的治疗策略。

items.title: Heterogeneity and ontogeny of mouse thymic macrophages reveal a requirement for Csf1r -expressing myeloid cells during early T cell development
items.abstract: Thymic macrophages (TMs) maintain tissue homeostasis by clearing the large numbers of apoptotic cells generated during T cell development, but how TM heterogeneity relates to their developmental origin and role in thymocyte maturation remains incompletely understood. Using complementary flow-cytometric, single-cell transcriptomic, and genetic approaches, we resolved two major TM populations corresponding to TIMD4 + cortical and CX3CR1 + medullary/cortico-medullary macrophages. TIMD4 + VCAM1 + TMs displayed a prominent efferocytosis and apoptotic-cell-clearance program, whereas TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs were enriched for antigen-presentation and interferon-response pathways. Fate mapping revealed unequal progenitor contributions to these populations, and CCR2 deficiency selectively reduced TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs, and thymic monocytes, supporting ongoing input from circulating precursors. Exploratory pseudotime analysis further identified a transcriptional continuum from Ly6c2 + Ccr2 + monocytes toward macrophage states. Using MaFIA fetal thymic organ cultures, AP20187-mediated depletion of Csf1r- expressing myeloid cells reduced CD4 + CD8 + thymocyte differentiation and produced a coordinated accumulation of DN3 cells, loss of DN4 cells, and reduction in CD27 expression. These convergent changes identify the DN3-to-DN4 transition as a developmental stage that requires an intact Csf1r -expressing myeloid compartment and establish a functional connection between the thymic myeloid niche and early αβ T cell development. Together, our study refines the phenotypic and developmental organization of mouse TMs and reveals a previously underappreciated requirement for myeloid-cell support during progression through the β-selection checkpoint.
items.title_zh: 小鼠胸腺巨噬细胞的异质性与发育揭示Csf1r表达的髓系细胞在早期T细胞发育中的必要性
items.summary_zh: 胸腺巨噬细胞（TMs）通过清除在T细胞发育过程中产生的大量凋亡细胞来维持组织稳态，但TM的异质性与其发育起源及在胸腺细胞成熟中的作用尚不完全清楚。通过流式细胞术、单细胞转录组学和遗传学方法，我们识别出两种主要的TM群体，分别对应于TIMD4 +皮质和CX3CR1 +髓质/皮质-髓质巨噬细胞。TIMD4 + VCAM1 + TMs显示出显著的吞噬凋亡细胞的能力，而TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs则富含抗原呈递和干扰素应答通路。命运追踪显示这些群体的祖细胞贡献不均，CCR2缺失选择性减少了TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs和胸腺单核细胞，支持循环前体的持续输入。探索性伪时间分析进一步识别出从Ly6c2 + Ccr2 +单核细胞到巨噬细胞状态的转录连续体。使用MaFIA胎儿胸腺器官培养，AP20187介导的Csf1r表达髓系细胞的去除减少了CD4 + CD8 +胸腺细胞分化，并导致DN3细胞的协调积累、DN4细胞的减少及CD27表达的降低。这些变化表明DN3到DN4的转变是一个需要完整Csf1r表达的发育阶段。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，胸腺巨噬细胞的异质性与发育对早期T细胞发育至关重要，Csf1r表达的髓系细胞在DN3到DN4的转变中发挥关键作用。
items.l2_summary:
胸腺巨噬细胞（TMs）在T细胞发育过程中发挥着重要作用，主要通过清除大量凋亡细胞来维持胸腺的组织稳态。然而，TMs的异质性、发育起源以及它们在胸腺细胞成熟中的具体作用尚不完全明确。通过流式细胞术、单细胞转录组学和遗传学方法，研究者识别出了两种主要的TM群体：TIMD4 +皮质巨噬细胞和CX3CR1 +髓质/皮质-髓质巨噬细胞。研究发现，TIMD4 + VCAM1 + TMs在吞噬凋亡细胞方面表现出显著的能力，而TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs则富含与抗原呈递和干扰素应答相关的通路。命运追踪实验表明，这两种TM群体的祖细胞贡献存在不均，CCR2缺失选择性减少了TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs和胸腺单核细胞，支持了循环前体的持续输入。

进一步的探索性伪时间分析揭示了从Ly6c2 + Ccr2 +单核细胞向巨噬细胞状态的转录连续体。通过使用MaFIA胎儿胸腺器官培养，研究者发现AP20187介导的Csf1r表达髓系细胞的去除显著减少了CD4 + CD8 +胸腺细胞的分化，并导致DN3细胞的协调积累、DN4细胞的减少及CD27表达的降低。这些结果表明，DN3到DN4的转变是一个需要完整Csf1r表达的关键发育阶段，进一步强调了Csf1r在早期T细胞发育中的必要性。这项研究不仅揭示了胸腺巨噬细胞的异质性及其发育机制，还为理解T细胞发育过程中的细胞间相互作用提供了新的视角。

items.title: Scanning and active sampling behaviours emerge from conserved insect neural circuits
items.abstract: Navigating insects often pause and rotate to sample their surroundings, behaviours termed scanning. These and other active sampling behaviours embody navigational uncertainty and are key for spatial learning, yet their neural basis remains unclear and existing models impose scanning behaviours rather than explaining its emergence. Here, we show that desert ants’ scanning dynamics can emerge spontaneously from the same conserved neural circuits used for goal-directed navigation, without requiring a specialised scanning module. We built a biologically grounded model combining central complex steering and lateral accessory lobe oscillators and added a downstream stochastic inhibition of forward speed. This minimal system produced diverse, realistic scan dynamics; saccades, fixations, and reversals, whose features were qualitatively compared to high-speed video recordings of Melophorus bagoti scanning. Detailed analysis of these natural scans confirmed model predictions, including how scan structure depends on oscillator phase, goal-heading deviation, and navigational uncertainty. Furthermore, the model reveals that simple modulation of forward speed unifies a broad range of behaviours across ant species, from dashes to smooth oscillatory trajectories to pirouettes and voltes. Crucially, this model suggests a distributed control principle where forward speed acts as a single adjustable parameter, for both individuals and through evolution, to regulate the balance between goal-driven exploitation and information-seeking exploration.

items.title: Cell-cycle-resolved Hi-C reveals unexpected plasticity of A/B compartments across interphase
items.abstract: The spatial organization of chromatin into active (A) and inactive (B) nuclear compartments is fundamental to genome regulation, yet their cell-cycle dynamics remain largely unexplored. Most research on chromatin dynamics during the cell cycle has primarily focused on events surrounding mitosis, providing only limited insight into chromatin behavior during S-phase. To address this gap, we developed a simple, drug-free approach that combines the Fucci cell-cycle indicator with in situ Hi-C to comprehensively analyze A/B compartment dynamics throughout interphase in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs). Unexpectedly, and contrary to prevailing views, we found that A/B compartment strength increased abruptly upon S-phase entry, stabilized during S-phase, and subsequently declined in late S/G2. This abrupt strengthening, which we termed ‘compartment maturation’, required passage through the G1/S transition but was independent of active DNA synthesis. This maturation involved substantial architectural remodeling, particularly within the A compartment, which consolidated into a more organized structure as individual A domains rearranged to form long-range interactions. Moreover, compartment maturation was not limited to mESCs but was also evident across different developmental contexts in mice. Based on these observations, we propose a revised, stepwise model of nuclear compartmentalization during cell-cycle progression, consisting of four distinct stages: chromosome unfolding (G1), chromatin maturation (G1/S), stabilization (S phase), and refolding (G2). These findings reveal the unexpected plasticity of A/B compartments and underscore the G1/S transition as a critical period for their reorganization.
items.title_zh: 细胞周期解析Hi-C揭示A/B区室在间期的意外可塑性
items.summary_zh: 染色质在活跃（A）和非活跃（B）核区室中的空间组织对基因组调控至关重要，但其细胞周期动态尚未得到充分研究。我们开发了一种简单的无药物方法，将Fucci细胞周期指示剂与原位Hi-C结合，全面分析小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESCs）在间期的A/B区室动态。意外地，我们发现A/B区室强度在S期开始时急剧增加，在S期期间稳定，随后在晚期S/G2下降。这种被称为“区室成熟”的急剧增强需要通过G1/S转变，但与活跃的DNA合成无关。成熟过程中，特别是在A区室内，发生了显著的结构重塑，个别A域重新排列形成长程相互作用。此外，区室成熟不仅限于mESCs，在小鼠的不同发育背景中也有明显表现。基于这些观察，我们提出了一个修订的核区室分层模型。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现小鼠胚胎干细胞在间期的A/B区室动态表现出意外的可塑性，特别是在S期的“区室成熟”过程中，A区室经历显著的结构重塑。
items.l2_summary:
染色质在细胞核中以活跃（A）和非活跃（B）区室的形式进行空间组织，这对基因组调控至关重要。然而，关于其在细胞周期中的动态变化尚未得到充分研究。为此，研究团队开发了一种简单的无药物方法，将Fucci细胞周期指示剂与原位Hi-C（高通量染色质相互作用捕获）技术结合，全面分析了小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESCs）在间期的A/B区室动态。研究意外发现，A/B区室的强度在S期开始时急剧增加，并在S期期间保持稳定，随后在晚期S/G2阶段下降。这一现象被称为“区室成熟”，其急剧增强需要通过G1/S转变，但与活跃的DNA合成并无直接关系。

在成熟过程中，特别是在A区室内，研究观察到显著的结构重塑，个别A域重新排列并形成长程相互作用。这一发现表明，区室成熟不仅限于mESCs，还在小鼠的不同发育背景中表现出明显的特征。基于这些观察，研究团队提出了一个修订的核区室分层模型，强调了细胞周期中染色质空间组织的可塑性及其在基因组调控中的重要性。这项研究为理解细胞周期对染色质结构的影响提供了新的视角，揭示了在不同发育阶段中染色质组织的动态变化。

items.title: NK2R signaling governs intestinal lipid mobilization and mucosal inflammation
items.abstract: Neuropeptidergic control of lipid metabolism is conserved and increasingly implicated in metabolic diseases, but receptor-level mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we identify the neurokinin-2 receptor (NK2R) as a central node linking tachykinin signals to intestinal lipid mobilization, epithelial composition, and mucosal inflammation. Across complementary genetic and pharmacological perturbations, modulation of NK2R drives bidirectional effects. Loss or blockade of NK2R increases postprandial triglyceridemia and expands intestinal lipid stores, whereas agonism suppresses chylomicron output, reduces adiposity, and improves glycemia in diet-induced obesity. Transcriptomic and cellular analyses indicate coordinated upregulation of lipid-metabolic programs with a concomitant dampening of immune pathways in the absence of NK2R, accompanied by sex-specific remodeling of secretory lineages and male-biased protection from colitis. NK2R signaling also shaped the fecal microbiota in a genotype- and diet-dependent manner, highlighting crosstalk among neuropeptide signaling, epithelial physiology, and host-microbe interactions. These findings position NK2R as a molecular switch for intestinal lipid handling and mucosal inflammation and suggest that NK2R-targeted agonists or antagonists could be deployed as context- and sex-dependent therapeutic strategies for metabolic disease and inflammatory bowel disease.
items.title_zh: NK2R信号调控肠道脂质动员与黏膜炎症
items.summary_zh: 神经肽对脂质代谢的调控在代谢疾病中越来越受到关注，但受体层面的机制尚不明确。本研究确定了神经激肽-2受体（NK2R）作为连接激肽信号与肠道脂质动员、上皮组成及黏膜炎症的核心节点。通过遗传和药理学干扰的互补研究，NK2R的调节表现出双向效应。NK2R的缺失或阻断会增加餐后甘油三酯水平并扩展肠道脂质储存，而激动剂则抑制乳糜微粒输出、减少脂肪量并改善饮食诱导的肥胖中的血糖水平。转录组和细胞分析表明，缺乏NK2R时脂质代谢程序的协调上调伴随免疫通路的抑制，且在性别特异性重塑分泌谱系和男性对结肠炎的保护中有所体现。NK2R信号还以基因型和饮食依赖的方式影响粪便微生物群，强调了神经肽信号、上皮生理和宿主-微生物相互作用之间的交叉对话。这些发现将NK2R定位为肠道脂质处理和黏膜炎症的分子开关，并建议NK2R靶向的激动剂或拮抗剂可作为代谢疾病和炎症的治疗策略。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示神经激肽-2受体（NK2R）在肠道脂质动员与黏膜炎症中的关键作用，表明其作为潜在治疗代谢疾病和炎症的靶点。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了神经激肽-2受体（NK2R）在肠道脂质动员与黏膜炎症中的重要作用，揭示了神经肽对脂质代谢调控的机制。研究表明，NK2R作为连接激肽信号与肠道脂质代谢、上皮组成及黏膜炎症的核心节点，其调节作用呈现出双向效应。具体而言，NK2R的缺失或阻断会导致餐后甘油三酯水平的增加，并扩展肠道脂质储存；而激动NK2R则能够抑制乳糜微粒的输出，减少脂肪量，并改善饮食诱导的肥胖中的血糖水平。

通过转录组和细胞分析，研究发现缺乏NK2R时，脂质代谢程序的协调上调伴随免疫通路的抑制，且这种效应在性别特异性重塑分泌谱系和男性对结肠炎的保护中得到了体现。此外，NK2R信号还以基因型和饮食依赖的方式影响粪便微生物群，强调了神经肽信号、上皮生理与宿主-微生物相互作用之间的复杂交互关系。这些发现将NK2R定位为肠道脂质处理和黏膜炎症的分子开关，提示NK2R靶向的激动剂或拮抗剂可能成为治疗代谢疾病和炎症的新策略。整体而言，本研究为理解神经肽在代谢疾病中的作用提供了新的视角，并为未来的治疗方法奠定了基础。

items.title: Human CD1c-autoreactive T-cells recognise Mycobacterium tuberculosis -infected antigen-presenting cells and display cytotoxic effector programmes
items.abstract: Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb), remains the leading cause of death from infection globally yet the contribution of non-classical T-cell pathways to human immunity remains poorly defined. CD1c-autoreactive T-cells, which recognise self-lipids presented by the antigen-presenting molecule CD1c, are frequent in human blood but their role during infection remains unclear. Here, we investigate how CD1c-expressing antigen-presenting cells (APCs) and Mtb infection shape CD1c-autoreactive T-cell responses using engineered human APC systems, complemented by single-cell transcriptomic profiling to define the ex vivo phenotypic landscape of these T-cells. CD1c is present within human TB granulomas, whereas Mtb down-modulates CD1c expression on infected APCs, consistent with an immune evasion strategy. CD1c-autoreactive T-cells respond more strongly to Mtb-infected CD1c + APCs than to uninfected cells, exhibiting enhanced activation, cytotoxicity, and diverse cytokine secretion via CD1c-dependent recognition. Under in vitro conditions, these T-cells reduce relative Mtb burden in infected phagocytes. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals cytotoxic effector-memory programmes and expression of antimicrobial molecules, providing a mechanistic basis for these responses. Together, these findings define a human CD1c-restricted T-cell response to Mtb-infected APCs and identify autoreactive CD1c-restricted T-cells as a candidate cellular axis for lipid-directed immunity in TB.
items.title_zh: 人CD1c自反应性T细胞识别结核分枝杆菌感染的抗原呈递细胞
items.summary_zh: 结核病（TB）由结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）引起，仍是全球感染导致死亡的主要原因，但非经典T细胞通路对人类免疫的贡献尚不明确。CD1c自反应性T细胞识别由抗原呈递分子CD1c呈递的自脂质，存在于人类血液中，但其在感染中的作用尚不清楚。本研究利用工程化的人类抗原呈递细胞（APC）系统，结合单细胞转录组分析，探讨CD1c表达的APC和Mtb感染如何影响CD1c自反应性T细胞的反应。结果显示，CD1c在结核病肉芽肿中存在，而Mtb感染下调感染APC上的CD1c表达。CD1c自反应性T细胞对Mtb感染的CD1c+ APC反应更强，表现出增强的激活、细胞毒性和多样的细胞因子分泌。在体外条件下，这些T细胞减少感染吞噬细胞中的Mtb负担。单细胞RNA测序揭示了细胞毒性效应记忆程序和抗微生物分子的表达，为这些反应提供了机制基础。这些发现定义了人类CD1c限制的T细胞对Mtb感染APC的反应。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了人CD1c自反应性T细胞在结核分枝杆菌感染中通过识别CD1c+抗原呈递细胞发挥增强的免疫反应，提供了新的机制基础。
items.l2_summary:
结核病（TB）是由结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）引起的全球性传染病，仍然是导致感染相关死亡的主要原因之一。然而，非经典T细胞通路在人体免疫中的作用尚未得到充分理解。本研究聚焦于CD1c自反应性T细胞，这类细胞能够识别由抗原呈递分子CD1c呈递的自脂质，并且存在于人类血液中，但其在结核感染中的具体作用仍不明确。研究团队利用工程化的人类抗原呈递细胞（APC）系统，结合单细胞转录组分析，探讨了CD1c表达的APC与Mtb感染对CD1c自反应性T细胞反应的影响。

研究结果表明，CD1c在结核病肉芽肿中存在，而Mtb感染则导致感染APC上CD1c表达的下调。值得注意的是，CD1c自反应性T细胞对Mtb感染的CD1c+ APC反应显著增强，表现出更强的激活、细胞毒性以及多样的细胞因子分泌。在体外实验中，这些T细胞能够有效减少感染吞噬细胞中的Mtb负担。通过单细胞RNA测序，研究揭示了这些T细胞的细胞毒性效应记忆程序和抗微生物分子的表达，为其反应机制提供了基础。

综上所述，本研究定义了人类CD1c限制的T细胞对Mtb感染APC的反应，强调了CD1c自反应性T细胞在结核病免疫应答中的潜在重要性。这些发现为深入理解结核病的免疫机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的疫苗和治疗策略开发提供理论依据。

items.title: A high-throughput assay for the measurement of Ca 2+ oscillations and insulin release from uniformly sized mouse β-cell (MIN6 ) spheroids
items.abstract: Diabetes mellitus is a rapidly growing global health challenge, necessitating the development of more effective anti-diabetic therapies, including drugs that improve insulin release from pancreatic β-cells. Traditional high-throughput screening methods typically rely on 2D β-cell cultures, but such cultures do not mimic the 3D organization and cell-to-cell communication of β-cells in pancreatic islets of Langerhans. Existing 3D β-cell culture models are hindered by high costs, technical complexity, and limited compatibility with high-throughput screening platforms. In this work, we developed an approach for generating 19 homogeneously shaped pancreatic β-cell spheroids in each well of a 96-well plate, using micropatterned polyethylene glycol (PEG)-based hydrogels and murine mouse insulinoma 6 (MIN6) insulinoma cells. The uniform shape and positioning of the individual spheroids enabled the simultaneous, real-time imaging of Ca 2+ signals in up to 1824 independent spheroids in response to glucose and various test compounds. Using this approach, we show that increasing glucose causes concentration-dependent Ca 2+ oscillations in individual spheroids, that these Ca 2+ oscillations are sensitive to modulators of ATP-sensitive K + channels, and that the frequency of Ca 2+ oscillations correlates with insulin secretion. Finally, we demonstrate that the neurosteroid pregnenolone sulfate, an agonist of the cation channel TRPM3, increases the frequency of glucose-induced Ca 2+ oscillations and enhances insulin release; the TRPM3 antagonist isosakuranetin inhibited these responses. In conclusion, we established a cost-effective and scalable 3D β-cell platform for high-throughput screening of insulin release-modifying compounds, with potential applications in drug development and personalized medicine for the management of diabetes mellitus.
items.title_zh: 高通量测定小鼠β细胞球体中Ca 2+波动与胰岛素释放的方法
items.summary_zh: 糖尿病是全球日益严重的健康挑战，需要开发更有效的抗糖尿病疗法，包括改善胰腺β细胞胰岛素释放的药物。传统的高通量筛选方法通常依赖于2D β细胞培养，但这种培养无法模拟胰岛素分泌细胞在胰腺胰岛的3D组织和细胞间通信。本研究开发了一种方法，在96孔板的每个孔中生成19个均匀形状的胰腺β细胞球体，使用微图案聚乙烯醇（PEG）基水凝胶和小鼠胰岛素瘤细胞（MIN6）。这种均匀的形状和定位使得能够同时实时成像多达1824个独立球体中的Ca 2+信号。结果表明，增加葡萄糖浓度会导致个别球体中Ca 2+波动的浓度依赖性变化，这些波动对ATP敏感的K +通道调节因子敏感，且Ca 2+波动的频率与胰岛素分泌相关。
items.l1_lead: 本研究开发了一种高通量方法，通过生成小鼠胰腺β细胞球体，实时监测Ca 2+波动，揭示其与胰岛素分泌的关系，为抗糖尿病疗法提供新思路。
items.l2_summary:
糖尿病已成为全球日益严重的健康挑战，迫切需要开发更有效的抗糖尿病疗法，尤其是改善胰腺β细胞胰岛素释放的药物。传统的高通量筛选方法多依赖于二维（2D）β细胞培养，但这种方法无法真实模拟胰腺胰岛中胰岛素分泌细胞的三维（3D）组织结构及细胞间的相互通信。为了解决这一问题，本研究开发了一种新方法，在96孔板的每个孔中生成19个均匀形状的胰腺β细胞球体，采用微图案聚乙烯醇（PEG）基水凝胶与小鼠胰岛素瘤细胞（MIN6）相结合。这种均匀的形状和定位使得研究人员能够同时实时成像多达1824个独立球体中的钙离子（Ca²⁺）信号。

研究结果显示，随着葡萄糖浓度的增加，个别球体中的Ca²⁺波动表现出浓度依赖性变化。这些Ca²⁺波动对ATP敏感的K⁺通道调节因子表现出敏感性，且Ca²⁺波动的频率与胰岛素的分泌密切相关。这一发现为理解胰腺β细胞在不同葡萄糖浓度下的功能提供了新的视角，并为未来开发针对糖尿病的治疗策略奠定了基础。通过这种新方法，研究者能够更好地模拟和分析胰腺β细胞的生理特性，从而为糖尿病的治疗提供更为有效的药物筛选平台。

items.title: The type VI secretion system governs strain maintenance in a wild mammalian gut microbiome
items.abstract: Bacteria inhabiting the mammalian gut coexist in dense communities where contact-dependent antagonism mechanisms are widespread. The type VI secretion system (T6SS) is an interbacterial toxin delivery pathway prevalent among gut Bacteroidales, yet its function in naturally evolved microbiomes remains poorly defined. Here, we examine the role of the T6SS in Bacteroides within a physiologically relevant gut community derived from wild mice (the WildR microbiome). Using newly developed genetic tools and a strategy for functional replacement of strains within the WildR community, we demonstrate that the WildR isolate B. acidifaciens employs a T6SS to antagonize co-resident Bacteroidales. We also show that loss of T6SS function compromises the long-term maintenance of B. acidifaciens in the community but not its initial colonization, establishing the system as a determinant of strain persistence. The T6SS we identified resides on an integrative and conjugative element (ICE). ICE-seq, a targeted sequencing approach, reveals that the T6SS-ICE is distributed among select Bacteroidales and Muribaculaceae species in the WildR microbiome, between which it appears to be recently exchanged. We also show that transfer of the T6SS-ICE to WildR isolate Phocaeicola vulgatus confers transient colonization benefits in mice, but is linked to eventual population decline. Our findings demonstrate that the T6SS can stabilize the presence of specific strains within a complex, co-evolved gut microbiome, yet its value is context dependent and constrained by the ecological and physiological landscape of the host community.
items.title_zh: VI型分泌系统在野生哺乳动物肠道微生物群中的作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了VI型分泌系统（T6SS）在野生小鼠肠道微生物群（WildR微生物群）中Bacteroides的作用。通过新开发的遗传工具和功能替代策略，我们发现WildR分离株B. acidifaciens利用T6SS对抗共生的Bacteroidales。结果表明，T6SS功能缺失会影响B. acidifaciens在微生物群中的长期维持，但不影响其初始定殖，确立了该系统作为菌株持久性的决定因素。我们还发现T6SS位于一个整合性和接合性元素（ICE）上，ICE-seq分析显示T6SS-ICE在WildR微生物群中的特定Bacteroidales和Muribaculaceae物种间分布，并且最近发生了交换。此外，将T6SS-ICE转移至WildR分离株Phocaeicola vulgatus可在小鼠中带来短暂的定殖优势，但最终与种群下降相关。
items.l1_lead: VI型分泌系统在野生小鼠肠道微生物群中对Bacteroides的长期维持至关重要，影响其与共生菌的竞争和定殖优势。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了VI型分泌系统（Type VI Secretion System, T6SS）在野生小鼠肠道微生物群（WildR微生物群）中Bacteroides属细菌的作用。研究通过新开发的遗传工具和功能替代策略，发现WildR分离株B. acidifaciens能够利用T6SS对抗共生的Bacteroidales细菌。实验结果表明，T6SS功能缺失会显著影响B. acidifaciens在微生物群中的长期维持，但并不影响其初始定殖，确立了T6SS作为菌株持久性的关键因素。

此外，研究还发现T6SS位于一个整合性和接合性元素（Integrative and Conjugative Element, ICE）上。通过ICE-seq分析，研究团队揭示了T6SS-ICE在WildR微生物群中特定Bacteroidales和Muribaculaceae物种间的分布情况，并且发现这些元素最近发生了基因交换。这一发现为理解微生物群中基因流动和生态相互作用提供了新的视角。

进一步的实验表明，将T6SS-ICE转移至WildR分离株Phocaeicola vulgatus能够在小鼠中带来短暂的定殖优势，但最终与种群的下降相关。这一结果提示，尽管T6SS-ICE在短期内可能促进某些菌株的竞争优势，但其长期影响可能导致种群的衰退。这项研究不仅揭示了T6SS在肠道微生物群中的重要作用，还为未来研究微生物群的动态平衡和生态相互作用提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Distinct allosteric remodeling of HIV-1 Env dynamics on virions by gp41-directed antibodies reveals two modes of neutralization
items.abstract: HIV-1 envelope glycoprotein (Env), a gp120–gp41 trimer, undergoes coordinated conformational changes that drive membrane fusion and allow immune evasion by transiently concealing neutralization-sensitive epitopes. Most broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) target gp120, whereas a distinct subset recognizes conserved gp41 regions, such as the fusion peptide and the membrane-proximal external region; however, their impact on Env dynamics and associated neutralization mechanisms remains unclear. By using bioorthogonal tagging for single-molecule FRET, we monitored real-time bNAb-induced conformational sampling of Env on intact virions. Most gp41-directed bNAbs allosterically stabilized the prefusion-closed (PC) state, whereas the bivalent 10E8.4/iMab favored both PC and CD4-bound open (predominant) states. Antibodies redistributed the conformational populations of Env with modest kinetic effects, preserving a sequential transition pathway. These findings reveal two modes of neutralization for gp41-directed antibodies, fixing the PC conformation and opening it up – in both cases, with neutralization occurring via long-range allosteric control of Env dynamics.

items.title: Mapping human visual contrast sensitivity and vision loss across the visual field with model-based fMRI
items.abstract: Peripheral vision is crucial for daily activities and quality of life, yet traditional measures of visual function like visual acuity primarily assess central vision. Visual field tests can evaluate peripheral vision but require extended focus and precise fixation, often challenging for patients with severe sight loss. Functional MRI (fMRI) with population receptive field (pRF) mapping offers a non-invasive way to map scotomas but relies on single contrast levels and accurate fixation. We developed an fMRI-based approach to measure contrast sensitivity across the visual field without requiring precise fixation. Combining large-field stimulation with varying spatial frequencies and contrast levels, and either pRF mapping or a structure-based retinotopic atlas, we modeled contrast sensitivity in the primary visual cortex (V1) over a large (40 deg) expanse of the visual field. In seven normally sighted participants, we characterized differences in V1 sensitivity across eccentricities and visual quadrants, finding reliable and reproducible patterns at individual and session levels. To test robustness to fixation variability, we investigated how varying levels of eye movement affected V1 sensitivity patterns in two participants: cortical sensitivity patterns were largely preserved despite eye movements, particularly at low spatial frequencies. This suggests our approach can accommodate several degrees of fixation instability, making it suitable for populations with unstable or biased fixation for whom visual field maps are harder to acquire behaviorally (e.g., patients with dense central scotoma or strabismus). Additionally, our method effectively visualized simulated and disease-linked sensitivity loss at the cortical level. Crucially, these results could be largely recovered using the structure-based retinotopic atlas, eliminating the need for pRF mapping and precise fixation, although with reduced sensitivity. This approach, integrating large-field stimulation with a retinotopic atlas, offers a promising tool for monitoring vision loss and recovery across a range of visual impairments, addressing a significant challenge in current clinical assessments.

items.title: Genome-wide discovery of cis- regulatory elements in a large genome
items.abstract: Identifying cis- regulatory elements typically relies on trial and error to test the activity of DNA fragments using reporter constructs. This approach is particularly challenging in large eukaryotic genomes, where cis- regulatory elements can be dispersed over long distances, separated by large stretches of non-functional DNA. Here, we generate two types of resources that can be used to narrow the search for such elements in the 3.6 Gbp genome of Parhyale hawaiensis . First, we use bulk ATAC-seq to uncover genome-wide patterns of chromatin accessibility in Parhyale embryonic and adult tissues, and single-nucleus ATAC-seq to identify regions of open chromatin in diverse cell types. Second, by sequencing the genomes of three congeneric species – P. darvishi , P. aquilina , and P. plumicornis – we identify islands of sequence conservation across the genome, likely corresponding to functionally constrained DNA. We find that low-coverage (10–15×) short-read genome sequencing, without genome assembly, is sufficient to provide reliable maps of sequence conservation. This approach cuts the cost and labour required to generate these maps, making the identification of cis- regulatory elements more widely accessible. We demonstrate the utility of these resources by identifying cis- regulatory elements that drive robust expression of fluorescent reporters ubiquitously and in specific cell types.
items.title_zh: 大基因组中顺式调控元件的全基因组发现
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在识别大真核生物基因组中的顺式调控元件，特别是在Parhyale hawaiensis的3.6 Gbp基因组中。我们采用了两种资源来缩小搜索范围：首先，利用大规模ATAC-seq揭示Parhyale胚胎和成体组织的全基因组染色质可及性模式，并通过单细胞核ATAC-seq识别多种细胞类型中的开放染色质区域；其次，通过对三种同属物种（P. darvishi、P. aquilina和P. plumicornis）进行基因组测序，识别出基因组中的序列保守岛，可能对应于功能受限的DNA。我们发现低覆盖率（10-15×）的短读长基因组测序，无需基因组组装，足以提供可靠的序列保守图谱。这种方法降低了生成这些图谱所需的成本和劳动，使顺式调控元件的识别更加广泛可及。我们通过识别驱动荧光报告基因在特定细胞和全局表达的顺式调控元件，展示了这些资源的实用性。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过低覆盖率短读长基因组测序，成功识别了大真核生物基因组中的顺式调控元件，降低了成本并提高了识别的可及性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在识别大真核生物基因组中的顺式调控元件，特别聚焦于Parhyale hawaiensis的3.6 Gbp基因组。为缩小搜索范围，研究团队采用了两种主要资源。首先，利用大规模的ATAC-seq（Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing）技术，揭示了Parhyale胚胎和成体组织的全基因组染色质可及性模式，并通过单细胞核ATAC-seq识别了多种细胞类型中的开放染色质区域。这一方法使得研究者能够更精准地定位潜在的顺式调控元件。其次，研究团队对三种同属物种（P. darvishi、P. aquilina和P. plumicornis）进行了基因组测序，以识别基因组中的序列保守岛，这些保守区域可能对应于功能受限的DNA序列。

研究发现，采用低覆盖率（10-15×）的短读长基因组测序，无需进行基因组组装，依然能够提供可靠的序列保守图谱。这种方法显著降低了生成这些图谱所需的成本和劳动强度，使得顺式调控元件的识别变得更加广泛可及。通过识别驱动荧光报告基因在特定细胞和全局表达的顺式调控元件，研究展示了这些资源的实用性，进一步验证了所采用的方法在基因组研究中的有效性和应用潜力。这项研究不仅为理解大真核生物基因组中的调控机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的基因组研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Sex-biased expression of enteroendocrine cell-derived hormones contributes to higher fat storage in Drosophila females
items.abstract: Enteroendocrine (EE) cells in the Drosophila gut produce and release multiple factors, including Allatostatin A (AstA), Allatostatin C (AstC), neuropeptide F (NPF), tachykinin (Tk), Diuretic hormone 31 (Dh31), Bursicon, CCHamide 1, CCHamide 2, and short neuropeptide F. Collectively, these peptides ensure that physiology (e.g., fat storage, fluid balance) and behavior (e.g., feeding, sleep) are coordinated with environmental factors such as nutrient quantity and quality. Despite notable sex differences in physiology and behavior, it remains unclear whether the regulation and function of these EE cell-derived factors are shared between males and females. Given that recent data identified sex-biased physiological effects of two EE cell-derived hormones on Drosophila food intake and energy mobilization, we performed a detailed characterization of these hormones in male and female flies. Despite an overall male bias in mRNA levels of AstA , AstC , Tk , NPF , and Dh31 in whole-body and head samples, we observed a strong female bias in mRNA levels of AstC , Tk , and NPF in the gut. To determine whether this sex-biased regulation was physiologically significant, we monitored triglyceride levels in flies with gut-specific knock-down of EE cell-derived hormones. In 5-day-old flies, knock-down of EE cell-derived AstC significantly reduced fat storage in females with no effect in males, whereas knock-down of EE cell-derived Tk produced a non-significant trend toward reduced fat storage in females. These female-specific effects on fat storage were reproduced in flies with neuron-specific knock-down of the AstC ( AstC-R2 ) and Tk receptors ( TkR99D ). Together, these data uncover strongly sex-biased regulation of EE cell-derived hormones and show that gut-specific knock-down of at least one of these hormones had a female-specific effect on body fat.
items.title_zh: 性别偏向的肠内分泌细胞激素表达影响果蝇雌性脂肪储存
items.summary_zh: 果蝇肠道中的肠内分泌（EE）细胞产生并释放多种因子，包括Allatostatin A（AstA）、Allatostatin C（AstC）、神经肽F（NPF）、速激肽（Tk）、利尿激素31（Dh31）等。这些肽共同调节生理（如脂肪储存、液体平衡）和行为（如进食、睡眠）与环境因素的协调。尽管生理和行为存在显著性别差异，但EE细胞衍生因子的调控和功能在雌雄果蝇中是否相同尚不明确。研究发现，AstC、Tk和NPF在雌果蝇肠道中的mRNA水平表现出明显的雌性偏向。通过监测肠道特异性敲低EE细胞衍生激素的果蝇甘油三酯水平，发现5天龄雌果蝇中AstC的敲低显著减少脂肪储存，而对雄果蝇没有影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，果蝇雌性肠内分泌细胞激素的表达偏向影响其脂肪储存，特别是敲低AstC显著减少雌果蝇的脂肪储存。
items.l2_summary:
研究表明，果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）肠道中的肠内分泌（EE）细胞产生并释放多种激素，包括Allatostatin A（AstA）、Allatostatin C（AstC）、神经肽F（NPF）、速激肽（Tk）和利尿激素31（Dh31），这些因子在调节果蝇的生理（如脂肪储存和液体平衡）和行为（如进食和睡眠）方面发挥着重要作用，并与环境因素相互协调。尽管已知生理和行为在雌雄果蝇中存在显著差异，但EE细胞衍生因子的调控和功能在雌雄果蝇中的差异尚未明确。

研究发现，AstC、Tk和NPF在雌果蝇肠道中的mRNA水平表现出明显的雌性偏向，表明这些激素在雌性果蝇中可能具有更为重要的生理功能。通过对肠道特异性敲低EE细胞衍生激素的果蝇进行监测，研究者发现，在5天龄的雌果蝇中，AstC的敲低显著减少了脂肪储存，而对雄果蝇则没有观察到类似的影响。这一结果表明，雌性果蝇对AstC的依赖性更强，可能与其脂肪储存机制的性别特异性有关。

综上所述，该研究揭示了性别偏向的肠内分泌细胞激素表达对果蝇雌性脂肪储存的影响，强调了在研究生理和行为时考虑性别差异的重要性。这为进一步理解性别在生物体内的生理调节机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: Bidirectional redistribution of actomyosin drives epithelial invagination in ascidian siphon tube morphogenesis
items.abstract: How epithelia perform a spatiotemporal heterogeneous force-generating program to drive a sequential tissue morphogenesis remains unclear, particularly the underlying precise mechanical mechanisms. This study investigated dynamic actomyosin reorganization between apical and lateral membrane cortex regions during two sequentially invaginated stages of atrial siphon tube morphogenesis in the ascidian Ciona . At the initial invagination stage, the originally lateral-located actomyosin redistributed to the apical domains, while that actomyosin redistributed back to lateral domains at the accelerated invagination stage. Using genetic mutants to modulate myosin activities, the initial invagination was strengthened or abolished, indicating invagination is apical constriction-dependent. Optogenetic inhibition of myosin activities in lateral domains after initial invagination stage blocked the further processes, suggesting lateral constriction of actomyosin is required for the accelerated invagination. Vertex model simulations uncovered a coupled mechanism underlying epithelial invagination driven by apicobasal tension imbalance and lateral contraction. We thus propose an actomyosin redistribution mechanical model: lateral actomyosin first redistributes apically to drive apical constriction and shape the initial invagination, then apical actomyosin redistributes laterally to promote lateral contractility and accelerate invagination. Our findings reveal a bidirectional reorganization of the actomyosin network as a central mechanism driving epithelial invagination, providing insights on epithelial invagination and organ morphogenesis during development.

items.title: A cortical–hippocampal communication undergoes rebalancing after new learning
items.abstract: The brain’s ability to consolidate a wide range of memories while maintaining their distinctiveness across experiences remains poorly understood. Sharp-wave ripples, neural oscillations that occur predominantly within CA1 of the hippocampus during immobility and sleep, have been shown to play a critical role in the consolidation process. More recently, evidence has uncovered functional heterogeneity of pyramidal neurons within distinct sublayers of CA1 that display unique properties during ripples, potentially contributing to memory specificity. Despite this, it remains unclear exactly how ripples shift the activity of CA1 neuronal populations to accommodate the consolidation of specific memories and how sublayer differences manifest. Here, we studied interactions between the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and CA1 neurons during ripples and discovered a reorganization of their communication following learning. Specifically, using a generalized linear model decoder, we demonstrated the pre-existence of ACC-to-CA1 communication, which is weakened during post-training sleep following learning, suggesting that ACC activity reallocates the contribution of CA1 neurons during memory formation. Interestingly, the reorganization appeared unique for a subset of CA1 superficial (CA1sup) neurons that were task inactive, whereas communication between the ACC and CA1deep neurons remained largely stable across pre- and post-training sleep. Consistent with this sublayer-selective reorganization, we found that optogenetic stimulations of the ACC preferentially suppressed CA1sup neurons while activating a unique subset of CA1 interneurons. Overall, these findings highlight an important role of the ACC in rebalancing CA1 neuronal populations’ contribution in learning and memory consolidation.
items.title_zh: 新学习后皮层-海马沟通的重组
items.summary_zh: 大脑在巩固多种记忆的同时保持其独特性能力尚不清楚。尖波涟漪是海马CA1区在静止和睡眠期间主要出现的神经振荡，已被证明在巩固过程中起关键作用。最近的研究发现CA1不同亚层的锥体神经元在涟漪期间表现出功能异质性，可能有助于记忆特异性。本文研究了前扣带皮层（ACC）与CA1神经元在涟漪期间的相互作用，发现学习后它们的沟通发生了重组。具体而言，我们使用广义线性模型解码器，证明了ACC与CA1之间的沟通在学习后睡眠期间减弱，表明ACC活动重新分配了CA1神经元在记忆形成中的贡献。值得注意的是，这种重组在一部分任务不活跃的CA1表层（CA1sup）神经元中显得独特，而ACC与CA1深层神经元之间的沟通保持不变。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，学习后前扣带皮层与海马CA1神经元的沟通重组，导致在睡眠期间CA1神经元的功能分配发生变化，从而影响记忆的特异性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了新学习后前扣带皮层（ACC）与海马CA1区神经元之间的相互作用重组，旨在揭示大脑在巩固多种记忆时如何保持其独特性。尖波涟漪是海马CA1区在静止和睡眠期间主要出现的神经振荡，已被证实在记忆巩固过程中发挥关键作用。研究发现，CA1不同亚层的锥体神经元在涟漪期间表现出功能异质性，这可能有助于记忆的特异性。

通过使用广义线性模型解码器，研究者们发现学习后ACC与CA1之间的沟通在睡眠期间显著减弱。这一发现表明，ACC的活动在学习后重新分配了CA1神经元在记忆形成中的贡献，可能影响了记忆的巩固过程。特别值得注意的是，这种沟通的重组主要发生在一部分任务不活跃的CA1表层（CA1sup）神经元中，而ACC与CA1深层神经元之间的沟通则保持不变。这一结果提示，ACC在学习后可能通过调节CA1神经元的活动模式，来优化记忆的巩固过程。

综上所述，本研究揭示了ACC与CA1神经元之间的沟通在学习后发生了重组，强调了ACC在记忆巩固中的重要角色，并为理解大脑如何在巩固多种记忆的同时保持其独特性提供了新的视角。

items.title: Negative affect influences the computations underlying food choice in bulimia nervosa
items.abstract: Individuals often consume tasty, calorically dense foods in response to negative emotions, a phenomenon exemplified by notions of ‘stress eating’ and ‘comfort food’. While this link between food and mood can become pathological in binge eating, the decision-making processes underlying this link are poorly understood. Here, we investigated the impact of acute increases in negative affect on when and how strongly the perceived tastiness and healthiness of foods influence food choices in healthy adults and individuals with bulimia nervosa (BN), an eating disorder characterized by cycles of over- and under-consumption of food. In a randomized crossover design, 25 women with BN and 21 healthy controls completed two sessions where they received either a neutral or negative affect induction and then completed a food choice task. Using a time-varying diffusion decision model, we assessed how negative affect influences food choice dynamics for high- and low-fat foods. In the neutral affect condition, individuals with BN considered tastiness relative to healthiness of high-fat foods sooner than healthy controls but maintained a restrictive food choice policy by reducing the weight on tastiness. After a negative affect induction, both groups showed a stronger bias toward considering tastiness before healthiness, but this bias was exaggerated in individuals with BN. This affect-induced bias for high-fat foods predicted more frequent subjective binge episodes over 3 months. These results provide insights into how negative emotion influences food choices and may explain why binge eating in BN is more likely during high negative affect, while dietary restriction is more likely during low negative affect.

items.title: Zinc is a key regulator of the sperm-specific K + channel (Slo3) function
items.abstract: The voltage- and pH-gated Slo3 potassium channel is exclusively expressed in mammalian spermatozoa. Its sensitivity to both voltage and alkalization plays a crucial role in sperm fertility, which is tightly coupled to the capacitation process. Here, we show that sperm-enriched divalent cation Zn 2+ undergoes dynamic alteration in spermatozoa during capacitation. We also found that intracellular Zn 2+ regulates alkalinization-induced hyperpolarization in mouse spermatozoa, which is mediated by the Slo3 channel. Further examination of zinc regulation in mouse Slo3 (mSlo3) revealed that, in the Xenopus oocyte expression system , intracellular zinc directly inhibits mouse Slo3 currents in a dose-dependent manner at micromolar concentrations, with exceptionally slow dissociation. By combining MD simulations and electrophysiology, we also identified amino acid residues contributing to the Zn 2+ slow dissociation from Slo3 channels. Our studies uncover the importance of intracellular zinc dynamics and its regulatory role in ion channels during sperm capacitation.

items.title: Biophysically inspired mean-field model of neuronal populations driven by ion-exchange mechanisms
items.abstract: Whole-brain simulations are a valuable tool for gaining insight into the multiscale processes that regulate brain activity. Due to the complexity of the brain, it is impractical to include all microscopic details in a simulation. Hence, researchers often simulate the brain as a network of coupled neural masses, each described by a mean-field model. These models capture the essential features of neuronal populations while approximating most biophysical details. However, it may be important to include certain parameters that significantly impact brain function. The concentration of ions in the extracellular space is one key factor to consider, as its fluctuations can be associated with healthy and pathological brain states. In this paper, we develop a new mean-field model of a population of Hodgkin–Huxley-type neurons, retaining a microscopic perspective on the ion-exchange mechanisms driving neuronal activity. This allows us to maintain biophysical interpretability while bridging the gap between micro- and macro-scale mechanisms. Our model is able to reproduce a wide range of activity patterns, also observed in large neural network simulations. Specifically, slow-changing ion concentrations modulate the fast neuroelectric activity, a feature of our model that we validated through in vitro experiments. By studying how changes in extracellular ionic conditions can affect whole-brain dynamics, this model serves as a foundation to measure biomarkers of pathological activity and provide potential therapeutic targets in cases of brain dysfunctions like epilepsy.
items.title_zh: 基于生物物理的神经元群体均场模型研究
items.summary_zh: 全脑模拟是理解调节脑活动的多尺度过程的重要工具。由于大脑的复杂性，无法在模拟中包含所有微观细节，因此研究者通常将大脑视为耦合神经团的网络，每个神经团由均场模型描述。本文开发了一种新的霍奇金-赫克斯利型神经元群体均场模型，保留了对驱动神经活动的离子交换机制的微观视角。该模型能够再现广泛的活动模式，特别是缓慢变化的离子浓度调节快速的神经电活动，这一特征通过体外实验得到了验证。我们的研究表明，细胞外离子条件的变化对整体脑活动有显著影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，细胞外离子浓度的变化显著影响整体脑活动，开发的均场模型有效再现了神经元群体的多种活动模式。
items.l2_summary: 全脑模拟是理解调节脑活动的多尺度过程的重要工具，但由于大脑的复杂性，研究者无法在模拟中包含所有微观细节。因此，通常将大脑视为由耦合神经团构成的网络，每个神经团由均场模型描述。本文开发了一种新的霍奇金-赫克斯利型（Hodgkin-Huxley type）神经元群体均场模型，旨在保留对驱动神经活动的离子交换机制的微观视角。该模型的创新之处在于能够再现广泛的神经活动模式，尤其是缓慢变化的离子浓度如何调节快速的神经电活动。通过体外实验验证，该模型的有效性得到了支持，显示出细胞外离子条件的变化对整体脑活动具有显著影响。这一发现强调了离子浓度在神经元活动中的关键作用，为未来的脑功能研究提供了新的视角和方法。整体而言，该研究不仅丰富了神经元群体均场模型的理论基础，也为理解大脑复杂动态提供了重要的实验依据。

items.title: Learning is a fundamental source of individuality
items.abstract: Learning and memory are essential components of our individuality. While it is established that behaviour can vary across genetically identical individuals, it remains unknown how much of this variation stems from momentary experience during learning compared to genetics and its past interactions with the environment. To address this, we measured behaviour in thousands of flies from 90 genetic backgrounds while they performed tasks in conditions that either did or did not require learning. Flies that were genetically identical, raised under the same conditions, and tested simultaneously in the same environment persistently modified the extent of expressed individuality when they could learn. This learning-induced residual expression of individuality and its dynamics were subdued or absent in innate, learning-independent behaviours. We could quantify and then recreate this phenomenon in computer simulations. The emergence of in silico behaviour individuality was most consistent with the individuality of real flies once we enabled reinforced learning in simulated agents. Moreover, we showed that minor differences in initial conditions of the experiment can exacerbate the expression of individuality within a genotype in a learning-dependent manner. Our results establish that besides the classical genotype × environment (G × E) interactions shared between individuals in the past, learning from individual momentary experience further extends the expression of individuality.

items.title: Gβγ engages PLCβ3 at multiple sites to reorient and facilitate its activation
items.abstract: Phospholipase C β (PLCβ) enzymes are activated by heterotrimeric G protein subunits, increasing hydrolysis of phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2) at the plasma membrane. All four human PLCβ isoforms (PLCβ1–4) are activated by Gα q , whereas PLCβ1–3 are activated to varying extents by Gβγ. The binding sites for Gα q on PLCβ are well established, and much has been learned about its mechanism of activation, but comparatively little is known about Gβγ-dependent activation. In this work, we used cryo-electron microscopy single-particle analysis, functional assays, and bioluminescence resonance energy transfer to investigate how Gβγ interacts with PLCβ3 in concert with activated Gα q to regulate phospholipase activity. Gβγ heterodimers bind multiple surfaces of PLCβ3 to promote activation, but alone do not recruit the enzyme to the plasma membrane. Instead, Gβγ facilitates activation by Gα q , most likely by reorienting the phospholipase catalytic site at the membrane to maximize PI(4,5)P2 hydrolysis and downstream Ca 2+ release. Cell-based functional assays demonstrate that Gβγ is required for maximal PLCβ3 activation, even when G q heterotrimers are the sole source of Gβγ. Together, these findings demonstrate that Gβγ acts as a critical positive allosteric modulator that regularly acts in concert with Gα q to activate PLCβ3 at the plasma membrane.

items.title: Clinical profiles, referral patterns and low vision aid prescribing across four rehabilitation centres in Ghana: protocol for a multicentre retrospective record review
items.abstract: BackgroundLow vision, defined as best-corrected visual acuity of less than 6/18 in the better eye or a visual field constriction of 20° or less, is a condition in which residual vision may be optimized through optical and non-optical aids. Despite the importance of low vision services in maximizing residual vision and supporting rehabilitation and quality of life, evidence on patient profiles and service delivery in Ghana remains limited. The HM KNUST Low Vision Project aims to address this service gap through a multicentre retrospective medical record review across four centres, characterizing patient profiles, referral patterns, and low vision aid prescribing to inform the strengthening of low vision services in Ghana.MethodsThe HM KNUST Low Vision Project is a collaboration between the Department of Optometry and Visual Science at Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana, and the Department of Applied Sciences and Mechatronics at Munich University of Applied Sciences, Germany. As part of this collaboration a comprehensive low vision patient form was developed in collaboration with Ghanaian optometric stakeholders and distributed to clinicians across selected pilot eye care facilities. The form captures biodata, systemic health, visual characteristics, referral patterns, and low vision aid prescriptions to facilitate standardized data collection across centres. Descriptive statistics will summarize patient characteristics, clinical profiles, referral patterns, and low vision aid prescribing. Inferential analyses will assess associations between patient and clinical characteristics, referral patterns, and prescribing patterns across participating centres.DiscussionThis study will provide multicentre evidence on low vision service delivery in Ghana, offering insights to guide rehabilitation services, clinical decision-making, and service planning. The standardized patient form will enable consistent characterization of patient needs, referral pathways, and low vision aid prescribing across centres, establishing an important foundation for improving the accessibility, consistency, and responsiveness of low vision care in Ghana.

items.title: Development and temporal validation of a calibrated machine learning model for in-hospital blood culture positivity using routine clinical data
items.abstract: BackgroundAmong hospitalized patients who have already undergone blood culture collection, routinely available clinical information may support early risk stratification while microbiological results are pending. We developed and temporally validated a calibrated machine learning model for in-hospital blood culture positivity.MethodsThis single-center retrospective study included 44,389 blood culture-related hospitalization records from January 2022 to September 2024. Records from 2022 to 2023 were used for model development and records from 2024 for temporal validation. The primary outcome was at least one laboratory-recorded positive blood culture between index collection and hospital discharge. A Platt-calibrated XGBoost model using demographic characteristics, routine laboratory variables, and missingness indicators was compared with procalcitonin-only and regression-based models. Performance was assessed using discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific metrics, decision curve analysis, and SHAP.ResultsThe cohort included 3,555 outcome-positive records (8.01%). In temporal validation, the final XGBoost model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.798 (95% CI, 0.784–0.813), a PR-AUC of 0.266, a Brier score of 0.0619, and a calibration slope of 1.061. At the 5% threshold, sensitivity was 0.877, specificity 0.570, and negative predictive value 0.983. XGBoost showed a modest improvement over logistic regression with missingness indicators, while an exploratory post hoc Age + PCT + BMI logistic comparator achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.757. Performance was stable in the new-patient validation subset but decreased within adult and pediatric subgroups (ROC-AUC 0.679 and 0.663, respectively). Age, procalcitonin, and body mass index were the dominant contributors.ConclusionThe calibrated model provided moderate discrimination and favorable calibration for hospitalization-level blood culture positivity risk stratification in the pooled temporal validation cohort. Performance varied across age groups, and much of the predictive information was concentrated in age, PCT, and BMI. The model does not predict the index culture result alone or diagnose clinically adjudicated bloodstream infection. Multicenter external and prospective validation using fixed prediction horizons and adjudicated outcomes is required before clinical implementation.

items.title: Modified frailty index versus risk analysis index for 30-day mortality after noncardiac surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract: BackgroundmFI and RAI are widely used in noncardiac surgical risk stratification, but they differ in content and data requirements. Because construct validity and outcome discrimination are distinct, we evaluated their prognostic discrimination for 30-day all-cause mortality without treating either instrument as a criterion-standard multidimensional frailty measure.MethodsThis PRISMA-aligned, prospectively registered systematic review used two complementary evidence levels: tool-specific random-effects meta-analyses across independent cohorts and direct within-study comparison. Standalone AUCs were pooled on the logit scale using REML with Hartung–Knapp inference and 95% prediction intervals. Risk of bias was assessed with QUIPS. CFS was analyzed post hoc as secondary exploratory evidence.ResultsSeventy-seven studies were included. For mFI, 39 independent cohorts yielded a pooled AUC of 0.634 (95% CI, 0.618–0.649; 95% prediction interval, 0.551–0.709). For RAI, 30 independent cohorts yielded 0.767 (95% CI, 0.737–0.795; 95% prediction interval, 0.579–0.888). Among 29 dual-tool studies, 21 had source-valid numeric comparisons in which RAI was higher, none had a source-valid numeric comparison in which mFI was higher, 2 supported RAI only qualitatively, and 6 could not be numerically classified; no paired meta-analysis was conducted because within-study covariance or delta-AUC standard errors were unavailable. Fourteen CFS studies were identified; 6 source-confirmed 30-day AUC cohorts yielded a post hoc exploratory AUC of 0.757 (95% CI, 0.618–0.857).ConclusionsRAI showed higher average prognostic discrimination than mFI, a pattern also observed in most directly comparative studies. Separate pooled AUCs are not a formal superiority test because case mix differs across studies. The analysis does not establish construct validity, and CFS evidence remains exploratory.Systematic Review Registrationhttps://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261378778, identifier PROSPERO, CRD420261378778.

items.title: Interdisciplinary care models for functional movement disorders: a systematic review of clinical effectiveness and implications for integrated healthcare delivery
items.abstract: IntroductionFunctional movement disorders (FMD) are a group of highly disabling conditions that are often managed through fragmented care, despite increasing support for interdisciplinary coordinated clinical approaches. This systematic review assessed the clinical efficacy and safety of interdisciplinary interventions in adults diagnosed with FMD.MethodsMEDLINE (Ovid), Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, CINAHL, PsycINFO, PEDro, INAHTA, trial registries, and HTA agency websites were searched from inception to October 2025. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing coordinated multidisciplinary/interdisciplinary interventions combining therapeutic components delivered by professionals from different discipline with non-coordinated or non-multidisciplinary care were included. Outcomes of interest included quality of life, motor function, mental health, and reported adverse events. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias-2 tool.ResultsMeta-analysis was not feasible because of substantial heterogeneity across studies. Five RCTs published between 2002 and 2024, including 186 participants (105 females) were included. One study was rated as having an overall high risk of bias. Compared with control interventions, interdisciplinary interventions may improve quality of life (physical domain) and motor function in the short to medium term, although findings were inconsistent across studies. No clear benefits were found for mental health status, overall clinical assessment, or social impact. Reported adverse events were infrequent and generally mild.PerspectiveThis systematic review synthesizes current evidence on interdisciplinary care in FMD. While short-term functional improvements have been noted, the uncertainty regarding the sustainability of these effects and their possible psychosocial impact underscores the necessity for rigorous longitudinal research in this population.Systematic Review RegistrationOSF (https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/56GYX).

items.title: Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, with spontaneous transdural and calvarial invasion: a case report and literature review
items.abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM), IDH-wildtype, is the most aggressive adult-type diffuse glioma. Although extracranial spread may occur after craniotomy, radiotherapy, or other interventions, spontaneous transdural and calvarial invasion before treatment is exceedingly rare. We report a 37-year-old woman who presented with long-standing right temporal-parietal headache and acute worsening with vomiting. Computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a right temporal mass with intratumoral hemorrhage, peritumoral edema, and contiguous extension through the dura and temporal bone into the temporalis muscle. The lesion was resected through a transcranial approach, and postoperative imaging showed gross total resection. Histological examination demonstrated an infiltrating high-grade glial neoplasm with brisk mitotic activity and palisading necrosis. Immunohistochemical and molecular findings, including the absence of IDH1/IDH2 mutations, supported a diagnosis of glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4. At 18 months after surgery, the patient remained alive. This case highlights a rare pattern of primary extracranial extension in GBM and suggests direct contiguous transdural invasion as a plausible route of spread in the absence of prior intervention.

items.title: Adapting the Girandole framework for cross-disciplinary social justice reflection in health professions education
items.abstract: Equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) are increasingly embedded within the standards and strategic priorities of health professions education. However, persistent inequities, hidden curricula and differences between institutional commitments and learners' lived experiences indicate a need for approaches that move beyond policy compliance towards critical, socially informed reflection. This Perspective paper explores the cross-disciplinary adaptation of the Girandole Framework, originally developed in nursing education, for application across health professions education. The framework uses six interconnected domains—Power, Hidden Curriculum, Professional Values, Personal Values, Culture, and EDI Education and Awareness—to support examination of the individual, cultural and structural influences shaping educational and professional experiences. An exploratory cross-disciplinary workshop involving healthcare professional students informed the adaptation of the framework. Informal discussions suggested that Power, Culture, and Personal and Professional Values were readily connected to learners' experiences. In contrast, Hidden Curriculum and EDI Education and Awareness required clearer language, practical examples and additional educational scaffolding. These insights informed the refinement of the framework's reflective prompts and the development of examples relevant to nursing, pharmacy, biomedical science and transferrable to other health professions. The adapted Girandole offers a shared language through which students and educators can critically examine power relationships, informal norms, professional cultures and educational omissions. Potential future applications include clinical and laboratory placements, professionalism teaching, portfolio-based learning, interprofessional education and curriculum review; however, these applications require empirical evaluation. The framework is intended to complement established reflective models by foregrounding equity and social justice. Further student–educator co-production and empirical evaluation are needed to assess its contribution to EDI literacy, belonging, reflective practice and meaningful organisational change across health professions curricula.

items.title: Case Report: Beyond the stomach: the role of preoperative imaging in assessing regurgitation risk in patients with esophageal dilatation: a report of two cases
items.abstract: BackgroundPerioperative regurgitation of gastric or esophageal contents remains a severe complication during anesthesia. While standard fasting protocols and rapid sequence induction (RSI) are routinely employed, esophageal dilatation creates a hidden reservoir for retained food and secretions that conventional methods often fail to mitigate. Furthermore, standard gastric ultrasound lacks the field of view to detect mid-to-proximal esophageal pooling.Case presentationWe present two parallel cases emphasizing this critical challenge. Case 1 involves a 68-year-old male with esophageal carcinoma who experienced massive regurgitation of white foam during RSI, despite five days of preoperative fasting. Airway security was ultimately achieved after intensified suctioning. Case 2 describes a 42-year-old female with achalasia and marked esophageal dilatation. Informed by preoperative computed tomography (CT) and barium swallow imaging, she was safely managed using targeted pre-anesthetic conscious endoscopic suctioning, leading to an uneventful induction and peroral endoscopic myotomy (POEM).ConclusionThese cases highlight the limitations of conventional fasting in managing proximal pooling. They underscore the diagnostic value of preoperative cross-sectional imaging, such as CT, when clinically indicated. Active pre-induction decompression, specifically through tailored endoscopic evacuation, is a valuable adjunctive strategy for preventing perioperative regurgitation in selected patients with megaesophagus.

items.title: Identification and validation of early vital sign trajectory subphenotypes for risk stratification in sepsis-associated liver injury: a multicenter retrospective cohort study
items.abstract: BackgroundSepsis-associated liver injury (SALI) is a serious clinical syndrome with heterogeneity in outcome among affected individuals. Physiological changes that are critical to outcome prediction are not considered in the existing system of stratification based on single-point observations. This could compromise the effectiveness of individualized treatment.ObjectiveTo develop and validate dynamic clinical subphenotypes of SALI using early vital sign trajectories.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study included 1,159 patients from MIMIC-IV as the derivation cohort and 168 patients from the Second Xiangya Hospital as the external validation cohort. Early vital sign trajectories within 12 h of ICU admission were summarized as trajectory-derived features and clustered using K-means. Candidate solutions (k = 2–6) were assessed using internal clustering metrics and bootstrap stability. A four-cluster solution was retained as an exploratory partition, considering trajectory interpretability and subgroup sizes. Clinical characteristics, organ support, and mortality outcomes were compared across the identified subphenotypes.ResultsFour exploratory SALI subphenotypes with distinct early vital sign trajectories were identified, ranging from relatively stable profiles to marked hemodynamic and physiological stress. Subphenotype 3 exhibited the most stable vital signs and was associated with lower adjusted 28-day (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.56–0.97) and 90-day mortality (HR 0.76, 95% CI 0.59–0.97) compared with the highest-risk Subphenotype 4. These prognostic differences were consistently replicated in the external cohort, supporting short- to intermediate-term prognostic generalizability.ConclusionEarly vital sign trajectories identified exploratory SALI groups associated with differences in 28-day and 90-day mortality. Their reproducibility, incremental prognostic value, and clinical utility require further evaluation.

items.title: Concurrent Bartholin gland and perianal abscesses in a woman: a case report of a diagnostic challenge
items.abstract: BackgroundBartholin gland abscess and perianal abscess are common suppurative infections involving anatomically adjacent regions of the female perineum. Because both conditions may present with localized pain and swelling, distinguishing their respective origins and determining the extent of infection can be challenging. The concomitant occurrence of these two abscesses is uncommon, and its diagnostic and therapeutic considerations remain poorly characterized. We report a rare case of concomitant Bartholin gland and perianal abscesses and describe the diagnostic process and multidisciplinary surgical management.Case presentationAn 18-year-old woman presented with progressive perineal and perianal pain and swelling. Pelvic computed tomography demonstrated abscess formation involving the perianal and left perineal soft tissues, and a possible communication between the two lesions was initially suspected. Emergency surgery was performed. The perianal abscess was incised and drained, and an infected anal gland was identified and excised, with bridge drainage established between the drainage incisions. Intraoperative exploration revealed no communication between the perianal abscess and the adjacent perineal lesion. Following gynecological consultation, the separate left vulvar abscess was drained and treated with Jacobi ring fistulization. Culture of the perineal abscess grew Escherichia coli, whereas the perianal abscess culture showed no bacterial growth. Follow-up magnetic resonance imaging 1 month after surgery demonstrated a cystic lesion in the anatomical region of the left Bartholin gland, supporting the Bartholin gland origin of the previously drained perineal abscess. The patient showed satisfactory clinical recovery, with complete healing of the perianal and perineal wounds at 4 months and no evidence of recurrent abscess during the available follow-up.ConclusionConcomitant Bartholin gland and perianal abscesses may be difficult to distinguish because of their overlapping clinical manifestations and anatomical proximity. Clinicians should consider the possibility of multiple independent or potentially related infectious foci and systematically evaluate adjacent anatomical regions. Careful physical examination, appropriate imaging, intraoperative assessment, and timely multidisciplinary collaboration can facilitate accurate diagnosis and individualized surgical management.

items.title: Expect the unexpected: cervical gastric-type adenocarcinoma in situ in a patient with long-standing Peutz-Jeghers syndrome — a case report and literature review
items.abstract: BackgroundPeutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS) is an autosomal dominant disorder caused by germline mutations in the STK11 tumor suppressor gene, associated with a significantly elevated lifetime risk of various malignancies. Gastric-type endocervical adenocarcinoma (G-EAC) and its precursor lesions represent one of the most challenging gynecologic manifestations due to their “deceptively bland” appearance, HPV-independent nature, and propensity to evade routine screening, often leading to delayed diagnosis and poor prognosis.Case presentationWe report a 37-year-old woman with a 30-year history of PJS, presenting with persistent watery vaginal discharge for one year. Despite negative cervical cytology, negative HPV testing, normal colposcopic findings, and inconclusive imaging, her request for hysterectomy was initially declined due to absence of definitive malignant features. The patient subsequently sought care at a tertiary referral center in Shanghai, where post-hysterectomy pathological examination unexpectedly confirmed cervical gastric-type adenocarcinoma in situ (GAS-AIS).ConclusionThis case highlights a critical message: a PJS patient with persistent watery vaginal discharge may harbor gastric-type cervical glandular neoplasia despite negative cytology, negative HPV testing, apparently normal cervical examination, and inconclusive imaging. Persistent watery discharge in this specific population should be considered a “red flag” for gastric-type lesions, which may arise from lobular endocervical glandular hyperplasia (LEGH). For PJS patients with persistent unexplained vaginal discharge, we suggest that clinical suspicion — rather than cytology or colposcopy findings — should be the primary trigger for diagnostic excisional procedures. We present a comprehensive literature review of PJS-associated G-EAC and advocate for updated surveillance protocols, including random cervical biopsies or excisional procedures in symptomatic PJS patients, regardless of colposcopic findings.

items.title: Effects of liraglutide on blood pressure and renal function in patients with type 2 diabetic nephropathy: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.abstract: ObjectivesThe effects of liraglutide on blood pressure in patients with T2DN remain unclear. This meta-analysis aimed to systematically evaluate the effects of liraglutide on blood pressure and renal function in patients with T2DN.MethodsWe conducted comprehensive searches of Web of Science, PubMed, the Cochrane Library, Elsevier ScienceDirect, CNKI, Wanfang Data, and VIP databases. Eligible studies were RCTs of ≥12 weeks’ duration evaluating liraglutide for T2DN. Two independent reviewers screened citations, extracted data, and assessed methodological quality using the Cochrane Risk-of-Bias Tool. Statistical analyses were performed in Stata 17.0 and RevMan 5.4, with effect sizes presented as RR or MD and 95% CI. The Cochrane Q test and I2 statistic were used to quantify statistical heterogeneity.ResultsThis meta-analysis included 23 RCTs involving 1,723 participants. Compared with the control group, liraglutide significantly reduced SBP [MD = −5.00, 95% CI (−7.17, −2.84)], while no significant effect was observed on DBP. In addition, liraglutide was associated with favorable changes in some renal biomarkers, as evidenced by reductions in Scr, UACR, Cys-C, BUN, and β2-MG, as well as elevations in eGFR. Improvements were also observed in glycemic control, lipid profiles, BMI, and inflammatory markers. Subgroup analyses indicated dose-dependent differences in UACR and LDL-C. In addition, both UACR and Scr were affected by intervention-regimen type, while HbA1c was affected by baseline albuminuria category. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the findings, and adjustment for publication bias did not alter the statistical significance of the key outcomes.ConclusionLiraglutide may be associated with favorable changes in selected BP, renal, metabolic, and inflammatory outcomes in patients with T2DN. However, further high-quality studies are needed to confirm these findings.Systematic Review Registrationhttps://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251232844, PROSPERO CRD420251232844.

items.title: A multi-class fundus disease classification framework based on self-supervised contrastive learning and dual-branch network
items.abstract: IntroductionFundus diseases including diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, and age-related macular degeneration are primary causes of blindness worldwide. Manual interpretation of retinal images is time-consuming and heavily reliant on clinical expertise. Although deep learning has shown promise in automated fundus image analysis, its performance remains highly data-dependent, requiring large amounts of expert annotations. Moreover, single-architecture models may have limited capacity to capture the diverse pathological features present in fundus images.MethodsThis study proposes a unified framework integrating self-supervised contrastive pre-training with a hybrid dual-branch architecture. Pre-training on unlabeled fundus images enables the model to learn generalizable representations, thereby reducing reliance on manual annotations. The dual-branch design combines EfficientNet-B4 for fine-grained detail extraction and MambaOut for large receptive field modeling. Their outputs are adaptively fused via a learnable cross-fusion module. A dendritic classifier is adopted to further improve classification performance. Comprehensive evaluations were conducted on two public datasets, OIHC and FIVES.ResultsOn the OIHC dataset, the proposed model achieved an F1-score of 96.32 ± 0.38% and a Kappa coefficient of 95.89 ± 0.43%. On the FIVES dataset, it attained 95.10 ± 0.54% and 93.49 ± 0.71%. The macro-average AUC exceeded 98% on both datasets. Ablation studies demonstrated the contribution of each component to the overall performance.ConclusionThis study indicates that combining self-supervised pre-training with a hybrid dual-branch architecture is a feasible approach for multi-class fundus disease classification. Interpretability analyses suggest that the model's attention regions partially overlap with clinically relevant pathological features. The framework achieved competitive performance on both datasets, showing its potential utility in scenarios with limited annotated data. Future work will focus on multi-center validation and model compression for lightweight architecture design.

items.title: Healthcare professionals’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding perioperative ischemic stroke in elderly patients
items.abstract: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate healthcare professionals’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) related to perioperative ischemic stroke in elderly patients.MethodsA single-center, cross-sectional survey was conducted at a tertiary hospital in Ningxia, China, between 1 March 2025 and 1 June 2025. Healthcare professionals were recruited by convenience sampling and completed a structured questionnaire covering demographic information and their KAP regarding perioperative ischemic stroke.ResultsA total of 273 valid responses were included in the final analysis. The majority of respondents were physicians (75.46%), with most affiliated with anesthesiology departments (86.08%). The scores for knowledge, attitude, and practice were 14.41 ± 4.22 (possible range: 0–20), 36.77 ± 3.57 (possible range: 8–40), and 30.07 ± 6.51 (possible range: 8–40), respectively. Structural equation modeling showed that knowledge, attitude, and practice were positively interrelated, whereas training related to perioperative ischemic stroke and specialization in elderly patient care showed negative associations with knowledge or practice (β range: −0.287 to 0.352; all P < 0.05). Knowledge was also indirectly associated with practice through attitude, whereas training and specialization in elderly care showed negative indirect associations with attitude and practice.ConclusionHealthcare professionals exhibited inadequate perceived knowledge, positive attitudes, and suboptimal practices regarding perioperative ischemic stroke in elderly patients. These findings underscore the necessity for targeted, evidence-based educational interventions to strengthen knowledge awareness and practice-related competencies, thereby addressing the observed gaps between perceived knowledge, attitudes, and reported practices.

items.title: Amelanotic subungual melanoma becoming clinically apparent within 24 h after minor blunt trauma: a case report
items.abstract: Amelanotic subungual melanoma (ASM) is a rare variant of nail unit melanoma (NUM) lacking melanin pigmentation, frequently misdiagnosed as a benign post-traumatic or infectious lesion. To our knowledge, ASM becoming clinically apparent within 24 h following minor blunt trauma has not been reported previously. We report the case of a 66-year-old male who presented with a persistent flesh-colored nodule beneath his right thumbnail that was manifested within 24 h after minor blunt trauma caused by nail clippers. The lesion was non-tender, non-pigmented, and unresponsive to 2 weeks of antibiotic therapy. Histopathology revealed diffuse subepidermal proliferation of atypical cells with signet-ring morphology. Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrated positivity for vimentin, HMB45, and Melan-A, and negativity for cytokeratin 5 (CK5) and S-100. Ki-67 was approximately 30%; Breslow thickness was 2.5 mm. Final diagnosis: ASM, AJCC stage IIA (T3aN0M0). Diagnostic excisional biopsy with a 2-mm margin was performed; sentinel lymph node biopsy of two axillary lymph nodes was negative. At 1-year follow-up, no local recurrence or distant metastasis was observed. This case demonstrates that ASM can become clinically evident within 24 h after acute trauma, likely through unmasking of a pre-existing subclinical tumor. For post-traumatic nail lesions unresponsive to antibiotics, early biopsy with a comprehensive IHC panel (including Melan-A, HMB45, and S-100) is essential.

items.title: Low arterial oxygen-content burden during the first 24 h and hospital mortality in mechanically ventilated adults: analyses of MIMIC-IV and eICU
items.abstract: BackgroundArterial oxygen content (CaO2) combines hemoglobin-bound and dissolved oxygen. A time-weighted CaO2 deficit could capture changing anemia and desaturation that a hemoglobin-only summary misses. We examined its association with hospital mortality and its added value beyond hemoglobin.MethodsIn this retrospective cohort study, we included mechanically ventilated adults from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV) and eICU Collaborative Research Database (eICU). The MIMIC-IV 25th percentile of the first matched CaO2 value (12.48 mL O2/dL) was prespecified as an empirical cutoff and was applied unchanged to eICU. The first-24-h burden integrated the time-weighted deficit below this cutoff. Models were adjusted for demographics and diagnosis-derived case mix. We compared CaO2 burden with hemoglobin burden calculated at the same blood-gas time points and performed landmark, measurement-coverage, severity, and post hoc peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO2)-stratified analyses.ResultsBurden was available for 14,050 MIMIC-IV and 20,780 eICU stays. CaO2 was strongly correlated with hemoglobin (r = 0.965 and 0.949, respectively), which explained R2 = 0.932 and 0.901 of first-measurement CaO2 variation, respectively; median dissolved-oxygen contributions were 2.9% and 2.5%, respectively. Per 1-SD higher burden, adjusted odds ratios for hospital mortality were 1.33 (95% confidence interval 1.28–1.39) in MIMIC-IV and 1.29 (1.24–1.35) in eICU. Additional Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation adjustment attenuated the eICU estimate to 1.14 (1.10–1.19), while 24-h landmark estimates were 1.26 (1.21–1.32) and 1.19 (1.14–1.25), respectively. Cross-validated area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) gains over matched hemoglobin burden were 0.006 and 0.010, respectively, and calibration was similar. In post hoc analyses, hemoglobin explained less CaO2 variation when first SpO2 was <90% (R2 = 0.787 and 0.682, respectively) than when it was ≥95% (R2 = 0.973 and 0.978, respectively); corresponding AUROC gains were 0.045 and 0.044 versus 0.002 in both databases.ConclusionIn cohorts dominated by preserved oxygen saturation, low CaO2 was predominantly an anemia-related signal, and its association with mortality was substantially attenuated by illness-severity adjustment. The burden is best viewed as a compact observational summary of the depth and duration of low arterial oxygen content, not as an independent measure of tissue oxygenation, a superior prediction model, or a treatment target.

items.title: Biomarker-guided immunotherapy in osteosarcoma: from immune microenvironment profiling to patient stratification and combination strategies
items.abstract: Osteosarcoma remains a therapeutically difficult malignancy, particularly after metastatic relapse, and immune checkpoint blockade or adoptive cell therapy has not reproduced the durable responses achieved in more immunogenic cancers. The central translational problem is not a complete absence of immune activity, but marked interpatient, intratumoral, and spatial heterogeneity in immune access, antigen presentation, myeloid suppression, stromal exclusion, and target-antigen expression. This Mini Review synthesizes recent single-cell and spatial profiling studies with tissue, circulating, and clinical biomarker evidence to define a practical framework for biomarker-guided immunotherapy. Osteosarcoma ecosystems can contain lymphoid-excluded, myeloid-dominant, angiogenic-hypoxic, checkpoint-rich, and antigen-high states that may coexist within the same patient. Consequently, programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) alone is unlikely to function as a reliable treatment-selection marker. A composite assessment integrating human leukocyte antigen (HLA) class I and antigen-processing competence, CD8/regulatory T-cell topology, macrophage and myeloid-derived suppressor cell programs, vascular and extracellular-matrix barriers, and quantitative surface-antigen density is more biologically defensible. Dynamic measurements, including circulating tumor DNA, soluble B7-H3, exosomal immune signals, and serial imaging, may complement tissue profiling but remain investigational. Clinical experience with checkpoint inhibitors, antiangiogenic combinations, mifamurtide, HER2-directed approaches, and emerging B7-H3-, GD2-, ALPL-1-, CD166-, IL-11Ralpha-, and NKG2D-based cellular therapies underscores the need to match mechanism to phenotype. Prospective studies should therefore use standardized, spatially resolved, and longitudinal biomarker panels to enrich trials, distinguish prognostic from predictive effects, and adapt therapy when immune exclusion or antigen escape emerges.

items.title: Osteopathic manipulative treatment as an adjunct therapy in a pediatric patient with chronic pancreatitis and visceral hyperalgesia: a case report
items.abstract: BackgroundChronic abdominal pain arising from visceral hyperalgesia is difficult to manage, and the use of osteopathic manipulative medicine in pancreatitis-associated visceral hyperalgesia is rarely described. This case adds to the literature by highlighting a potential integrative, mechanism-informed approach for pain modulation in a complex pediatric patient.CaseA 17-year-old male with chronic pancreatitis in the setting of a heterozygous SPINK1 N34S (c.101A > G; p.Asn34Ser) variant, presented with acute-on-chronic abdominal pain severe enough to require escalating opioid therapy; imaging demonstrated calcifications, edema, and peripancreatic fluid collections. A multimodal treatment plan was initiated that included gabapentin, nortriptyline, and targeted osteopathic manipulative treatment. A secretin-enhanced MRCP obtained during a prior admission one month earlier demonstrated pancreatic calcifications, edema, and peripancreatic fluid collections. During the current hospitalization, serum lipase decreased from 979 U/L on admission to 90 U/L by hospital day 3, when gabapentin, nortriptyline, and targeted osteopathic manipulative treatment were initiated as part of a multimodal treatment plan. The patient had two sessions of osteopathic treatment and they were each associated with reductions in pain without adverse effects. As-needed opioid medications were discontinued by discharge as part of a multimodal therapy plan. The patient remained pain-free at one-month follow-up with minimal opioid use, suggesting a potential role for osteopathic manipulative medicine as part of a multimodal strategy in the treatment of chronic pancreatitis related pain.
