HF diet and viral infection independently associated with increased placental Fat/Cd36 mRNA expression at GD12.5. However, HF diet and infection associated with increased ir-FR- while HF diet alone decreased ir-PCFT at GD12.5. By GD15.5, HF diet associated with reduced placental ir-FR- but increased ir-PCFT. At GD18.5, infection associated with reduced Rfc1 mRNA expression. HF diet and infection associated with greater prevalence of SGA and LGA fetuses, particularly at GD18.5. Obesity and infection independently and jointly disrupted placental morphology and nutrient transporter expression in a zone- and gestational age-specific manner, with consequences for fetal growth across gestation.
items.authors: Ferraz, T.; Cardoso, L.; Mohammadkhani, S.; Bloise, E.; Connor, K.

items.title: Structural features and conservation of the lncRNA HOTAIR in primates
items.abstract: Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) regulate diverse cellular processes and are frequently implicated in disease, but their functional mechanisms often remain elusive. One such lncRNA, HOTAIR (Hox transcript antisense intergenic RNA), is a ~2.1 kb mammalian transcript whose overexpression promotes invasion and metastasis in breast cancer. However, the mechanisms by which HOTAIR influences gene regulation in cancer are poorly understood. To approach this problem through a structural lens, we predicted the full-length in cellulo secondary structure of HOTAIR using chemical probing in a metastatic breast cancer cell line. The resulting structure shows that HOTAIR adopts a multidomain architecture and has local structural features unique to the cellular context. Comparison between in vitro and in cellulo chemical probing identifies regions of differential accessibility that may indicate context-dependent molecular interactions or folding. Conservation analyses further reveal that HOTAIR is conserved across primates with evidence of structural covariation in specific domains. Together, these results provide a roadmap for future mechanistic studies of structure-function relationships in HOTAIR and its contribution to gene regulation in cancer.
items.authors: Perry, Z. R.; Beeram, A.; Lee, L.; Pyle, A. M.

items.title: Synthetic genetic circuits that count developmental cues in plant roots
items.abstract: Plants explore soil environments through their roots, which branch repeatedly to access water and soil-borne nutrients. In many plants, root branches are generated by repeated developmental programs and molecular analyses have not identified markers that distinguish primary from later root branches. Consequently, efforts to engineer plant roots for improved water or nutrient acquisition are limited to changes that affect the entire root system. Here, we developed synthetic genetic circuits to count repeating root development cues and enable differential gene expression in successive root branches of the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana. The circuits use a root primordium-specific promoter to express large serine recombinases, which irreversibly invert segments of DNA each time a new lateral root is initiated. This converts repeating rounds of root formation into distinct, heritable DNA states. Because root branch specification and outgrowth occur over a ~2 day period, we tested circuit designs for their ability to count long-duration input pulses and developed an architecture that produces distinct fluorescence outputs in primary, secondary, and tertiary roots. By linking repeated developmental cues to distinct genetic outputs, synthetic genetic circuits that count enable root system engineering at the resolution of individual branches and offer a general strategy for dissecting developmental processes that rely on repeated signals.
items.authors: Choi, S.; Brophy, J. A. N.

items.title: Molecular sterics guide tmRNA translocation on the ribosome
items.abstract: Translation of defective mRNA transcripts can lead to the formation of stalled ``non-stop'' ribosome complexes. To rescue these ribosomes, bacteria have evolved a mechanism called trans-translation that is mediated by transfer-messenger RNA (tmRNA) and small protein B (SmpB). During the translocation step of trans-translation, the stalled mRNA is ejected and the reading frame found in the mRNA-like domain (MLD) of tmRNA is loaded into the mRNA channel. The ribosome then translates the new template, thereby tagging the nascent protein for degradation. While structures of tmRNA-SmpB on the ribosome have been available for years, little is known about the molecular factors that govern the dynamics of tmRNA translocation. Here, we use an energetically smooth model (i.e. SMOG) to simulate translocation of tmRNA-SmpB, which reveals that the structure of the ribosome gives rise to a preferred sequence of conformational substeps. Specifically, the tRNA-like domain (TLD) translocates, then the MLD loads, and finally the C-terminal tail of SmpB rearranges. These steps are interdependent and associated with a range of sterically-induced barriers that regulate the kinetics. This provides a structural and energetic framework for understanding, and ultimately controlling, the dynamics of trans-translation.
items.authors: Wanes, G.; Keiler, K. C.; Dunham, C. M.; Whitford, P. C.

items.title: Amide I kurtosis maps cardiac amyloid in human tissue by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) microscopy
items.abstract: Cardiac amyloidosis is caused by deposits of misfolded proteins in the heart and can lead to heart failure. Histological confirmation typically involves staining tissue sections with Congo red and examining them under polarized light for apple-green birefringence; however, achieving an interpretable, label-free, and observer-independent assessment remains challenging. Here we show that Pearson kurtosis of channel intensities within the amide I window provides an interpretable, fitting-free contrast for cardiac amyloid in unstained human cardiac tissue sections from ten participants imaged by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS). In a discovery participant, high-kurtosis regions corresponded with Congo red-positive tissue in two CARS-histology pairs of adjacent sections (descriptive spatial AUCs, 0.79 and 0.73). Across 15 fields from nine additional participants, field-level kurtosis values did not overlap between severe-deposition and Congo red-negative tissue fields. Among the descriptors examined, kurtosis showed the largest standardized participant-level separation. Exploratory multivariate curve resolution yielded a deposit-associated component with aromatic-residue features shared with reagent transthyretin. In one field from the discovery participant, the second harmonic generation (SHG) signal, acquired simultaneously with CARS, showed a broadly inverse spatial pattern relative to the amide I kurtosis map, revealing distinct tissue-architectural contrast. Together, these findings support a potential label-free approach to detecting cardiac amyloid deposits that combines amide I kurtosis derived from broadband CARS with SHG-derived architectural contrast.
items.authors: Ota, K.; Chen, T.-H.; Yamaguchi, T.; Otsubo, T.; Murakami, Y.; Masaki, M.; Leproux, P.; Suzuki, R.; Node, K.; Kano, H.

items.title: Potassium modulates Phytophthora zoospore motility and flagellar beating through dose-dependent effects
items.abstract: Biflagellate zoospores are critical agents in the spread of Phytophthora spp., plant pathogens causing major agronomic and economic losses worldwide. These motile cells navigate soil water films toward plant roots using taxis triggered by environmental cues. Here, we investigate how potassium modulates zoospore motility by analyzing trajectory and flagellar beating parameters across KCl concentrations. Using high-speed imaging, we apply kymograph analysis and Fourier transform of the cell body direction over time to quantify flagellar dynamics, while low-speed imaging provides trajectory characteristics. Our results demonstrate that increasing potassium concentration significantly reduces swimming speed while enhancing directional changes. We establish a direct correlation between altered swimming speed and changes in flagellar beating parameters. Our findings indicate that potassium differentially affects anterior and posterior flagella beating. Furthermore, potassium exerts multiple effects, influencing beat amplitude, wave propagation speed and direction- change frequency. This reveals potassium as a key modulator of zoospore motility, triggering a shift from exploratory swimming to confined, reoriented movement. By uncovering the biomechanical responses of zoospores to potassium, this study advances our understanding of how surrounding signals regulate pathogen dispersal in the environment.
items.authors: Lupatelli, C. A.; ATTARD, A.; Galiana, E.; Cohen, C.; Thomen, P.; Noblin, X.

items.title: STRUCTURAL AND MOLECULAR DYNAMICS ANALYSIS OF HUMAN β-DEFENSIN 1 VARIANTS REVEALS DISTINCT PERTURBATION SIGNATURES
items.abstract: Human {beta}-defensin 1 (hBD-1) is a small, disulfide-constrained antimicrobial peptide produced predominantly in the kidney and urogenital tract, where it contributes to epithelial innate defense. Genetic variation in the gene encoding hBD-1 has been associated with altered expression levels and susceptibility to infections, including infection following solid organ transplantation, yet the molecular consequences of coding substitutions in the active, mature form remain largely undefined. Here, we integrate conventional genomics, protein bioinformatics, structural modeling, and molecular dynamics to investigate the molecular consequences of 93 human-observed hBD-1 missense variants. Evaluation of hBD-1 missense variants across sequence-, structure-, and dynamics-based dimensions reveals variant-specific molecular perturbation signatures that complement conventional and static biophysical predictions. By treating naturally occurring substitutions as a perturbation series across a compact defensin scaffold, this study identifies multiple molecular routes through which sequence variation can remodel an endogenous antimicrobial peptide and prioritizes variants for direct structure-function testing. These findings provide a mechanistic framework for investigating how naturally occurring hBD-1 variation may influence peptide behavior and, ultimately, antimicrobial function.
items.authors: Fogarty, R. J.; Urrutia, R.; Pinto e Vairo, F.; Hong, J. C.; Lomberk, G.

items.title: Cross-linker binding strength influences actin assembly microstructure and myosin II driven remodeling
items.abstract: The actin cytoskeleton is a self-assembled material that acts as the mechanical scaffold of the cell. Within the cell, protein cross-linkers organize actin filaments into assemblies with various microstructures that support distinct physiological functions. These protein cross-linkers differ in structural features. To decouple the role of individual cross-linker properties in actin assembly microstructure and mechanics, we synthesize programmable cross-linkers using a DNA linker coupled to binding domains. We find that high affinity cross-linkers induce actin bundling, while low affinity cross-linkers form actin networks. Myosin II motors remodel and contract all cross-linked networks tested in distinct ways from uncross-linked networks. We find that networks with high affinity cross-linkers have different myosin induced dynamics than networks with low affinity cross-linkers. This research expands our understanding of how cells regulate their mechanics and microstructures, while also providing insight towards the structure-property relationship in complex soft materials.
items.authors: Feigeles, C. A.; Janquart, M.; Armstrong, V.; Weirich, K. L.

items.title: Synthesis and characterization of NIR fluorescent BODIPY-Xanthene hybrid dyes
items.abstract: The development of NIR fluorescent dyes with favorable optical properties is of great importance especially for applications within the field of optical imaging. In this study, we report the design, synthesis and photophysical characterization of novel BODIPY-Xanthene hybrid dyes obtained via Knoevenagel condensation between an asymmetrical BODIPY core and the functionalized xanthene aldehydes intermediates. The synthesized dyes ex-hibit absorption (667 nm) and emission bands (720-722 nm) within the NIR region. Detailed UV-Vis and fluo-rescence studies were performed and molar extinction coefficients and stokes shifts also calculated. Moreover, findings highlighting the influence of structural modifications on the optical behavior of the hybrid dyes and their potential utility in optical imaging applications are reported.
items.authors: Nigianni, G.; Katsamakas, S.; Alexandratou, E.; Prousis, K. C.

items.title: Quantification of cellular contributions to multi-cellular pattern formation
items.abstract: Multi-cellular pattern formation is a key process in organism development, regeneration, and disease. Such multi-cellular patterns include, for instance, cell density and gene expression patterns. Here, we develop a cell-track-based method that quantifies how much individual cellular processes contribute to the emergence of large-scale patterns. These cellular processes include changes in cellular expression levels, cell motion, cell divisions, and apoptosis. We validate our method using synthetic data, before demonstrating it on two sets of experimental data. Our method is purely geometric and does not require any mechanistic assumptions about the underlying pattern-forming processes, making it very generic and robust. It thus enables unbiased, data-driven study of the mechanisms driving pattern formation across a broad class of systems.
items.authors: Estavoyer, M.; Zhao, M. L.; Merkel, M.
items.title_zh: 细胞对多细胞模式形成的贡献量化研究
items.summary_zh: 多细胞模式形成是生物体发育、再生和疾病中的关键过程，包括细胞密度和基因表达模式等。本文开发了一种基于细胞轨迹的方法，量化个体细胞过程对大规模模式出现的贡献。这些细胞过程包括细胞表达水平变化、细胞运动、细胞分裂和凋亡。我们使用合成数据验证了该方法，并在两组实验数据上进行了演示。该方法纯粹是几何性的，不需要对基础模式形成过程的任何机械假设，使其具有高度的通用性和稳健性。因此，它能够无偏见、数据驱动地研究驱动模式形成的机制，适用于广泛的系统。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新方法，量化个体细胞在多细胞模式形成中的贡献，具有高度通用性和稳健性，适用于多种生物系统。
items.l2_summary:
多细胞模式形成是生物体在发育、再生和疾病过程中至关重要的现象，涉及细胞密度和基因表达模式等多个方面。为深入理解这一过程，本文开发了一种基于细胞轨迹的方法，旨在量化个体细胞过程对大规模模式形成的贡献。这些细胞过程包括细胞表达水平变化、细胞运动、细胞分裂和凋亡等。通过合成数据的验证，研究表明该方法能够有效捕捉到细胞行为与模式形成之间的关系。

在实验中，研究者对两组实验数据进行了演示，进一步验证了该方法的有效性。值得注意的是，该方法的几何性特征使其不依赖于对基础模式形成过程的任何机械假设，这赋予了其高度的通用性和稳健性。因此，研究者能够无偏见、数据驱动地探讨驱动模式形成的机制，适用于多种生物系统。

总的来说，该研究为理解细胞在多细胞模式形成中的作用提供了一种新的量化工具，能够帮助科学家更好地解析细胞行为与生物模式之间的复杂关系。这一方法的提出不仅丰富了细胞生物学的研究手段，也为相关领域的研究提供了新的视角和思路。

items.title: Microscopic collisions govern macroscopic aerotactic spreading through emergent transport coefficients
items.abstract: Collective migration is often attributed to complex cell-cell communication, yet coordinated multicellular dynamics can also emerge in organisms lacking social interactions. Continuum descriptions successfully capture such behaviors but generally rely on phenomenological transport coefficients whose microscopic origin remains elusive. Here we show that these coefficients emerge from cell-cell collisions and can be independently determined from experiments. We investigate the aerotactic dispersal of confined colonies of the solitary amoeba Acanthamoeba castellanii, in which oxygen consumption continuously reshapes the local environment to generate self-organized guidance cues. Combining quantitative videomicroscopy, oxygen mapping with phosphorescent sensing films, and oxygen-controlled microfluidics, we directly measure both the oxygen landscape and the aerotactic response governing colony expansion. We then develop a Patlak-Keller-Segel (PKS) -type drift-diffusion model whose transport coefficients are entirely determined from independent experiments and microscopic-to-macroscopic modeling approach, without adjustable parameters. The model quantitatively reproduces the observed dynamics, including the coexistence of a fast ballistic front and a trailing transient accumulation band. We show that both diffusion and aerotactic transport are modulated by the same collision-controlled mechanism through density-dependent changes in cell persistence. More generally, our results establish transport coefficients as measurable emergent properties bridging microscopic cell dynamics and macroscopic collective behavior, providing a predictive framework for oxygen-guided migration in living active matter.
items.authors: Ghazi, N.; Hirose, S.; Funamoto, K.; Calvez, V.; Anjard, C.; Cochet-Escartin, O.; Demircigil, M.; RIEU, J.-P.

items.title: A deep learning-generated hASIC1a miniprotein inhibitor confers neuroprotection in stroke
items.abstract: Ion channels remain notoriously recalcitrant drug targets despite their extensive pathophysiological significance. Acid-sensing ion channels (ASICs) are proton-gated cation channels that cause neuronal death when excessively activated, such as during ischaemic stroke. This acidosis-driven injury pathway remains unchallenged by existing therapeutics. Here we generate two de novo designed hASIC1a-specific miniproteins by developing a platform that integrates computational miniprotein design, high-throughput automated patch clamp screening, biophysical and structural characterisation, and in vivo validation. We identify a subtype-selective hASIC1a inhibitor, Denasin1, which achieves near-complete inhibition with nanomolar potency. Denasin1 is disordered in solution but adopts the computationally predicted helix-turn-helix fold when bound to the extracellular acidic pocket of hASIC1a. Crucially, Denasin1 reduces infarct volume by > 50% in a murine model of ischaemic stroke. We thereby establish our de novo design platform as a route to develop potent and selective ion channel modulators.
items.authors: Sormann, J.; Epitropaki, K.; Vicino, M. F.; Fjorbak, C. L.; Pugh, C. F.; Lang, B.; Beyer, E. K.; Comaposada-Baro, R.; Hink, F.; Friis, S.; Usher, S. G.; Cai, C.; Autzen, H. E.; Rogers, J. M.; Pless, S.

items.title: Structural Insights into the Expanded Substrate Scope of a Cysteine-Dependent Hydrolase from Rhodococcus opacus for Polyethylene, Polypropylene, and Polystyrene Biodegradation
items.abstract: Microplastic pollution from homopolymers such as polypropylene (PP), polystyrene (PS), and polyethylene (PE) poses growing health and environmental concerns, highlighting the need for robust polymer-degrading biocatalysts. We previously identified a naturally occurring cysteine-dependent hydrolase (CsdH) from Rhodococcus opacus, featuring a unique Cys160-Lys127-Asp39 catalytic triad and providing a novel mechanism for polyethylene terephthalate (PET) degradation. In this study, we have determined crystal structures of CsdH in complex with PP, PS, PE, and styrene and demonstrated the potential of the enzyme to directly degrade these homopolymers into their respective low molecular weight degradation products using LC-MS. Structural analysis reveals that the enzyme retains a conserved principal access tunnel while undergoing subtle substrate-dependent changes to accommodate different substrates. The enzyme exhibited broad plastic degradation activity with the highest weight loss observed for PE, followed by PP and PS. SEM analysis reveals surface roughness, cracks and grooves, confirming polymer degradation. Further, these results corroborate through FTIR and TGA analysis. These findings establish a strong foundation for enzyme engineering and aim at developing efficient microplastic degradation.
items.authors: Aggarwal, S.; Singh, S.; Kayastha, A.; Aggarwal, D.; Jangid, K.; Shakib, M.; Singh, D.; Sharma, A. K.; Kumar, P.

items.title: A transient third metal ion shapes the catalytic cycle of a group I intron ribozyme
items.abstract: The self-splicing group I intron ribozyme from Tetrahymena thermophillia (THr) is a prototypical example of how RNA overcomes its limited chemical repertoire to form complex, negatively charged junctions and catalyze chemical reactions. Despite over 30 years of biochemical and structural characterization, questions still remain regarding the requirements for THr catalysis that may inform structure based drug design against group I introns, as well as the use of THr as an RNA editing tool. Recent cryo-EM structures have provided an unprecedented window into the first and second steps of splicing, enabling detailed mechanistic investigation at the atomistic level. In this work, we leverage solvation theory, molecular dynamics, alchemical free energy simulations, and machine learning accelerated QM/MM to probe outstanding questions related to 1) the role of a possible third Mg2+ binding in the active site, 2) differences in catalytic requirements between Gexo cofactors and between the first and second steps of splicing, 3) the potential role of an acid or base, and 4) restrictions on the identity of the 5' exon splice site nucleotide, U(-1). We propose that a transient, cofactor dependent, interaction with a third metal participates in the first step, while a higher affinity interaction with this third ion is required in the second step. We also propose that the presence of a phosphate on the Gexo in the first step, and analogously the G{omega} in the second step, forms a metal ion binding site not present when guanosine is bound. Finally, we propose and computationally test design modifications of G22 (isofunctional substitutions of 2,6-diaminopurine that tune the pKa at the N1 position) that we predict will enable the accommodation of C(-1) in a crucial wobble-like pair at physiological pH. This design would provide a potential strategy for expanding the sequence space accessible to programmable trans-splicing ribozymes in RNA editing applications.
items.authors: McCarthy, E.; Ekesan, S.; Giese, T. J.; Du, Y.; Barletta, G. P.; Götz, A. W.; Piccirilli, J. A.; York, D. M.

items.title: Physical Basis Of pKa Shift For Ionizable Lipids In An LNP-like Environment
items.abstract: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are a leading drug delivery platform for mRNA or other nucleic acid-based therapeutics. LNP platforms are typically composed of ionizable aminolipids, phospholipids, sterols, and lipids tagged with polyethylene glycol. The ionizable aminolipids are typically cationic at low pH, allowing them to encapsulate negatively charged mRNA. The pH at which the ionizable head groups change charge states, the apparent pKa, is crucial to understand the characteristics and formulation of LNP. However, this is difficult to measure as the apparent pKa differs from the pKa of the aminolipids in bulk solution due to the complex chemical and charge environment. In this study, we use molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with alchemical free energy perturbation to calculate the pKa shift as a function of lipid composition, treating LNP-like and vesicle-like environments. Our results show that the pH-dependent structure of the systems affects the trends in pKa shifts in complex ways, driven by factors including surface electrostatics and lipid internalization. Our all-atom simulation protocol allows us to efficiently estimate the apparent pKa of LNP-like models formed with novel ionizable aminolipids and estimate how it will change with composition.
items.authors: Sharma, A.; Sur, S.; Grossfield, A.

items.title: Crowding governs resistance confinement and guides the improvement of adaptive therapy in a 2D melanoma model system
items.abstract: The emergence of treatment resistant mutants is one of the primary contributors to therapy failure in cancer. Evolution-based adaptive therapies aim to exploit the competition between sensitive and resistant cells to prolong therapeutic control. However, in the densely packed tissues of solid tumors, competition is not only determined by cell-intrinsic factors but also a result of local physical interactions between neighboring cells. The successful development of physics-informed adaptive therapies therefore hinges upon the bottom-up integration of tissue mechanics and experimentally grounded models of tumor evolution. Here, we show how population-level treatment response emerges from mechanical interactions between individual cells. Combining genetically tailored therapy-mimicry experiments in spatially structured 2D melanoma colonies with mechanistic, particle-based tissue simulations as digital twins in a real-to-sim-to-real framework, we reveal how treatment-induced changes in mechanical crowding shape a cascade of resistance expansion, spatial competitive escape, and consequent therapy failure. We then link these underlying physical mechanisms to population-level observables in an abstracted mathematical model for reinforcement-learning-based therapy optimization and a distilled treatment-decision-heuristic, which we test experimentally. Together, our results identify mechanical crowding and escape as governing principles of resistance-mediated therapy failure in solid tumours and provide a basis for mechanistically informed, evolution-based treatment strategies.
items.authors: Kayser, J.; Eiche, M.; Fischer, E. F.; Smith, A.-S.; Milas, M.; Citak, T.; Aif, S.
items.title_zh: 拥挤效应影响耐药性限制并指导适应性治疗改进
items.summary_zh: 治疗耐药突变体的出现是癌症治疗失败的主要原因之一。基于进化的适应性治疗旨在利用敏感细胞与耐药细胞之间的竞争来延长治疗控制。然而，在实体肿瘤的高密度组织中，竞争不仅由细胞内在因素决定，还受到邻近细胞之间局部物理相互作用的影响。我们展示了个体细胞之间的机械相互作用如何导致群体层面的治疗反应。通过将基因定制的治疗模拟实验与基于粒子的组织模拟结合，我们揭示了治疗引起的机械拥挤变化如何形成耐药性扩展、空间竞争逃逸及随之而来的治疗失败的级联效应。我们将这些物理机制与基于强化学习的治疗优化和实验测试的决策启发式模型联系起来。我们的结果识别了机械因素在治疗耐药性中的重要作用。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，细胞间的机械相互作用在癌症治疗中影响耐药性扩展，揭示了拥挤效应对治疗反应的重要性，并为适应性治疗提供了改进方向。
items.l2_summary:
治疗耐药突变体的出现是癌症治疗失败的主要原因之一。为了解决这一问题，基于进化的适应性治疗旨在利用敏感细胞与耐药细胞之间的竞争，以延长治疗的有效控制。然而，在实体肿瘤的高密度组织中，这种竞争不仅受到细胞内在因素的影响，还受到邻近细胞之间的局部物理相互作用的影响。研究表明，个体细胞之间的机械相互作用能够显著影响群体层面的治疗反应。通过结合基因定制的治疗模拟实验与基于粒子的组织模拟，研究团队揭示了治疗引起的机械拥挤变化如何导致耐药性扩展、空间竞争逃逸及随之而来的治疗失败的级联效应。

具体而言，研究发现，当细胞在高密度环境中相互作用时，机械拥挤的变化会影响细胞的生长和生存策略，从而促进耐药细胞的扩展。这一过程不仅涉及细胞之间的直接接触，还包括细胞外基质的变化和细胞间信号传递的调节。通过这些物理机制，耐药细胞能够在治疗压力下逃逸竞争，导致治疗效果的下降。

此外，研究还将这些物理机制与基于强化学习的治疗优化和实验测试的决策启发式模型相结合，提出了一种新的治疗策略。这种策略能够更好地考虑机械因素在治疗耐药性中的重要作用，从而为癌症治疗提供新的思路和方法。总的来说，这项研究强调了在癌症治疗中考虑细胞间机械相互作用的重要性，并为改进适应性治疗提供了新的理论基础和实践指导。

items.title: Grow2Fold: mapping heterogeneous developmental growth to human brain folding
items.abstract: Cortical folding emerges through complex developmental processes, yet what organizes these processes into the characteristic folding patterns of the human brain remains unclear. Here, we developed an imaging-informed whole-brain modeling framework, Grow2Fold, that integrates developmental cortical regionalization, quantitative growth characterization, and mechanics-guided simulation to investigate how cortical growth shapes brain folding patterns. Using 836 fetal and neonatal MRI sessions from 747 participants spanning 21-45 postmenstrual weeks, we identified a reproducible and hierarchical spatiotemporal organization of cortical expansion characterized by coordinated regional growth trajectories. Rapid expansion occurs earlier around peri-central territories and progressively shifts toward frontal, parietal, and temporal association cortices. We encoded these imaging-derived trajectories into region- and age-specific growth laws and incorporated them into anatomically realistic whole-brain mechanical models. The resulting simulations recapitulate major sulcal landmarks and characteristic folding development across global and regional morphological measures. Comparing regional and uniform growth, we find that differential growth drives cortical instability, while heterogeneous developmental growth organizes this instability into anatomically recognizable folding patterns. Combined with subject-specific anatomy, these population-informed growth laws reproduce individualized longitudinal folding trajectories. Together, our results identify spatiotemporally patterned developmental growth as a key spatial constraint on cortical morphogenesis and establish a quantitative bridge from developmental imaging, through mechanical instability, to anatomically organized folding.
items.authors: Hou, J.; Solhtalab, A.; Jiang, K.; Gu, B.; Li, T.; Chen, X.; Wu, T.; Song, K.; Liu, Y.; Song, W.; zhu, D.; Liu, T.; Kuhl, E.; Li, G.; Razavi, M. J.; Wang, X.

items.title: CryoFAST: A Fab-Aided Cryo-EM Workflow for High-Resolution Structure Determination of Sub-50-kDa Protein Targets
items.abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) plays an increasingly important role in structure-based drug discovery (SBDD) by revealing target protein-ligand interactions at the molecular level, but its application has largely focused on large- and medium-sized protein complexes. Many therapeutically important targets are smaller than 50 kDa and remain highly challenging for cryo-EM analysis because of low signal-to-noise ratios and difficulties in particle alignment. Here, we describe cryoFAST, an integrated workflow that couples ligand-compatible Fab discovery and structure-guided computational maturation with biochemical triage, fiducial-complex assembly, and single-particle cryo-EM. Through phage-display screening and/or AI-guided design, we developed high-affinity Fab binders of approximately 50 kDa that stabilize the target without disrupting ligand-target interactions and then assembled Fab-target complexes for cryo-EM analysis. Using the therapeutically relevant extracellular domain (~20 kDa) of interleukin-4 receptor (IL-4R) as a proof of concept, we determined its cryo-EM structure at 2.74 Angstrom resolution and established a framework for elucidating ligand-binding modes. This workflow provides a practical, efficient, and potentially broadly applicable route to the structural characterization of small protein targets that are otherwise challenging to study. By extending the applicability of cryo-EM to high-value but technically challenging small targets, cryoFAST may open new opportunities for structure-based drug discovery.
items.authors: Li, X.; Deng, S.; Li, W.; Qian, Y.; Li, Y.; Du, J.; Li, L.; Qian, D.

items.title: Structural Basis for Near Infrared Absorption and Noncanonical Photoisomerization in Neorhodopsin
items.abstract: In retinal proteins, light absorption leads to a double bond isomerization of the chromophore, followed by conformational relaxations that drive functional protein rearrangements. The balance between photoisomerization and radiative or non-radiative decays of the excited state is adjusted to the demands of the respective photoreceptor function. The molecular determinants controlling the excited state processes remain poorly understood and are the focus of this combined crystallographic, spectroscopic, and theoretical work on the recently discovered neorhodopsin (NeoR). NeoR exhibits a highly red-shifted and fluorescent dark state and selectively photoisomerizes from all-trans to 7-cis. We show that the local electrostatic environment reduces the negative charge density near the Schiff base and suppresses torsional motion around the canonical C13=C14 isomerization site of microbial rhodopsins. Instead, the chromophore-binding pocket permits only low-efficiency C7=C8 isomerization, accompanied by polyene inversion, {beta}-ionone ring displacement, and Schiff base deprotonation. Consequently, unlike other retinal photoreceptors, NeoR undergoes structural changes localized near the {beta}-ionone ring.
items.authors: Kovalev, K.; Boehlke, B.; Nag, P.; Grosse, M.; Kraskov, A.; Katz, S.; Hildebrandt, P.; Bartl, F.; Schapiro, I.; Hegemann, P.; Broser, M.

items.title: Adipose Tissue Pericellular Fibrosis, Weight Loss and Features of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease after Bariatric Surgery
items.abstract: Introduction: Adipose tissue fibrosis has been associated with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and suboptimal weight loss after bariatric surgery. The objective was to characterize changes in adipose tissue fibrosis and extracellular matrix (ECM) components in adipose tissues from two abdominal fat compartments, subcutaneous and omental, in response to bariatric surgery; and determine the effect of weight loss on the association between adipose tissue fibrosis and MASLD feature changes with weight loss. Methods: Liver and adipose tissue biopsy samples were obtained before and after weight loss from patients who underwent two-stage bariatric surgery. Adipose tissue pericellular fibrosis was evaluated histologically with picrosirius red staining for collagen quantification and normalized to adipocyte count per microscope field. Transcript levels of ECM remodeling and inflammatory genes were measured by RNA sequencing in subcutaneous adipose tissue pre- and post-surgery. Results: At baseline, adipose tissue pericellular fibrosis did not associate with MASLD features, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis or hepatic fibrosis in patients with severe obesity. Changes in liver histology after surgery were unrelated to changes in adipose tissue fibrosis. Transcripts for most genes involved in ECM remodeling and inflammation were downregulated in subcutaneous fat one year after bariatric surgery. Omental, but not subcutaneous, adipose tissue fibrosis decreased after surgery when adjusted for cell number (mean {+/-} SD: 0.41 {+/-} 0.12 vs 0.32 {+/-} 0.08 {micro}m2/cell, p<0.005). Higher subcutaneous adipose tissue fibrosis correlated with reduced weight loss (estimate {+/-} SE: -2.04 {+/-} 0.99, p<0.05) and BMI loss (-0.73 {+/-} 0.35, p<0.05), while increased omental adipose tissue fibrosis after weight loss was associated with worsening hepatic fibrosis (0.31 {+/-} 0.14, p<0.05). Conclusion: In individuals with severe obesity undergoing bariatric surgery, adipose tissue fibrosis is poorly correlated with MASLD features. Notably, pericellular fibrosis in subcutaneous abdominal, but not omental, adipose tissue was associated with a reduced weight-loss response to surgery.
items.authors: Tremblay, E.-J.; de Toro Martin, J.; Lebel, S.; Couture, C.; Lajeunesse-Trempe, F.; Maltais-Payette, I.; Ostinelli, G.; Vohl, M.-C.; Biertho, L.; Mauriege, P.; Tchernof, A.
items.title_zh: 肥胖手术后脂肪组织细胞周围纤维化、体重减轻与代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝特征
items.summary_zh: 引言：脂肪组织纤维化与代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）及肥胖手术后体重减轻不理想相关。本研究旨在表征肥胖手术后，来自皮下和大网膜两种腹部脂肪区的脂肪组织纤维化及细胞外基质（ECM）成分的变化，并确定体重减轻对脂肪组织纤维化与MASLD特征变化之间关系的影响。方法：从接受两阶段肥胖手术的患者中获取术前和术后肝脏及脂肪组织活检样本。通过皮克罗西里红染色评估脂肪组织细胞周围纤维化，并根据显微镜视野内脂肪细胞计数进行标准化。术前和术后皮下脂肪组织中ECM重塑和炎症基因的转录水平通过RNA测序进行测量。结果：基线时，脂肪组织细胞周围纤维化与MASLD特征、代谢功能障碍相关性脂肪肝或肝纤维化无关。手术后肝组织病理变化与脂肪组织纤维化变化无关。大多数与ECM重塑和炎症相关的基因转录水平下调。
items.l1_lead: 肥胖手术后，脂肪组织细胞周围的纤维化与代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝特征无关，且手术后ECM重塑和炎症基因转录水平普遍下调。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了肥胖手术后脂肪组织细胞周围的纤维化、体重减轻与代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）之间的关系。研究的主要目的是表征来自皮下和大网膜两种腹部脂肪区的脂肪组织纤维化及细胞外基质（ECM）成分的变化，并确定体重减轻对这些变化的影响。研究对象为接受两阶段肥胖手术的患者，研究团队获取了术前和术后的肝脏及脂肪组织活检样本。

在方法上，研究通过皮克罗西里红染色评估脂肪组织细胞周围的纤维化程度，并根据显微镜视野内的脂肪细胞计数进行标准化。同时，术前和术后皮下脂肪组织中ECM重塑和炎症基因的转录水平通过RNA测序进行测量。结果显示，在基线时，脂肪组织细胞周围的纤维化与MASLD特征、代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝或肝纤维化之间并无显著关联。此外，手术后肝组织的病理变化与脂肪组织的纤维化变化也未显示出相关性。值得注意的是，大多数与ECM重塑和炎症相关的基因转录水平在术后均出现下调。

综上所述，本研究表明，肥胖手术后脂肪组织的纤维化与MASLD特征之间并不存在直接的关联，且体重减轻对脂肪组织纤维化的影响有限。这一发现为理解肥胖手术后患者的代谢功能障碍及其与脂肪肝病的关系提供了新的视角，提示在临床治疗中可能需要更全面的评估和干预策略。

items.title: An AI-Enabled Translational Drug Discovery Framework for NALCN Channelopathy: From High-Throughput Screening to Therapeutic Candidate
items.abstract: Background: More than 90% of rare diseases lack an approved therapy, partly reflecting economic barriers in developing treatments for small patient populations. A common bottleneck is costly and resource-intensive hit-to-lead prioritization. Congenital contractures of the limbs and face, hypotonia, and developmental delay (CLIFAHDD) is an ultra-rare neurodevelopmental disease often caused by de novo gain-of-function variants in the sodium leak channel NALCN, with no approved treatments. Methods: We developed a cost and resource-efficient, AI-enabled translational drug discovery framework integrating phenotypic high-throughput screening (HTS), structural biology foundation models for hit-to-lead prioritization, and orthogonal experimental validation. We applied this framework for drug repurposing to identify NALCN inhibitors as therapeutic candidates for CLIFAHDD. We screened ~1,200 approved drugs using a fluorescence-based membrane potential assay in doxycycline-inducible HEK293 cells stably expressing the NALCN channelosome. Boltz-2 modeling predicted binding affinity and mode to prioritize hits. Lead repurposing candidates were selected by a multidisciplinary expert review panel. Lead candidates were evaluated using patch-clamp electrophysiology in HEK293 cells expressing wild-type or CLIFAHDD-associated NALCN variants, primary mouse hippocampal neurons, and a C. elegans NALCN gain-of-function model. Results: HTS identified 11 candidate NALCN inhibitors. Boltz-2 prioritized candidates based on predicted binding affinity and predicted binding within the NALCN pore, consistent with a direct pore-blocking mechanism. Aprepitant emerged as the lead candidate after multidisciplinary evaluation based on its predicted mechanism, pharmacologic properties, blood-brain barrier penetration, established safety profile, and regulatory approval in children and adults. Patch-clamp electrophysiology confirmed partial inhibition of NALCN-mediated sodium leak currents in HEK293 cells (IC50;=2.22 M), with comparable potency against Cav3.1 (IC50=1.63 M). In primary mouse hippocampal neurons, aprepitant reduced sodium leak currents, hyperpolarized resting membrane potential, and decreased spontaneous firing. Aprepitant rescued hyperlocomotor and dystonic phenotypes in a C. elegans gain-of-function NALCN model. There was notable concordance between AI-predicted hits, phenotypic screening hits, and experimental validation. Conclusion: These findings identify aprepitant as a lead therapeutic candidate for CLIFAHDD, and establish an AI-enabled translational drug discovery framework integrating phenotypic screening, structural modeling, and experimental validation for NALCN channelopathies. This scalable and resource-conscious strategy may accelerate hit-to-lead prioritization and drug discovery for rare and ultra-rare diseases lacking effective therapies.
items.authors: Thongsepee, N.; Tanner, J. A.; Polusani, S.; Typou, A.; Clanton, N. A.; Holmes, B. B.; Lory, P.; Dwyer, D. S.; Zhou, D.; Monteil, A.; Yuan, Y.
items.title_zh: 基于人工智能的NALCN通道病转化药物发现框架
items.summary_zh: 背景：超过90%的罕见疾病缺乏批准的治疗方案，部分原因是针对小患者群体开发治疗的经济障碍。CLIFAHDD是一种超罕见的神经发育疾病，通常由钠泄漏通道NALCN的去新生功能变异引起，目前没有批准的治疗。方法：我们开发了一种成本和资源高效的人工智能驱动的转化药物发现框架，整合了表型高通量筛选（HTS）、结构生物学基础模型用于命中优先级排序，以及正交实验验证。我们应用该框架进行药物重定位，以识别NALCN抑制剂作为CLIFAHDD的治疗候选者。我们使用荧光膜电位测定法筛选了约1200种已批准药物。Boltz-2建模预测了结合亲和力和模式以优先排序命中。通过多学科专家评审小组选择了重定位的候选药物，并在HEK293细胞及小鼠海马神经元中进行了电生理评估。
items.l1_lead: 研究开发了一种基于人工智能的药物发现框架，成功识别出NALCN抑制剂作为超罕见神经发育疾病CLIFAHDD的潜在治疗候选药物。
items.l2_summary:
在罕见疾病的治疗领域，超过90%的疾病缺乏批准的治疗方案，部分原因在于针对小患者群体开发治疗的经济障碍。CLIFAHDD是一种超罕见的神经发育疾病，通常由钠泄漏通道NALCN（sodium leak channel, non-selective）的去新生功能变异引起，目前尚无批准的治疗方法。为了解决这一问题，研究团队开发了一种基于人工智能的转化药物发现框架，该框架具有成本和资源高效的特点，整合了表型高通量筛选（HTS）、结构生物学基础模型用于命中优先级排序，以及正交实验验证。

在这一框架下，研究者们进行了药物重定位，以识别NALCN抑制剂作为CLIFAHDD的潜在治疗候选者。具体而言，研究团队筛选了约1200种已批准的药物，采用荧光膜电位测定法进行评估。通过Boltz-2建模，研究者预测了药物的结合亲和力和结合模式，从而对筛选结果进行了优先排序。最终，经过多学科专家评审小组的选择，确定了重定位的候选药物，并在HEK293细胞及小鼠海马神经元中进行了电生理评估。

这一研究不仅展示了人工智能在药物发现中的应用潜力，还为CLIFAHDD等超罕见疾病的治疗提供了新的思路和可能的解决方案。通过高效的筛选和验证流程，该框架为未来罕见疾病的药物开发提供了可行的路径，尤其是在面对经济和资源限制的情况下。

items.title: Mechanistic simulation identifies predictive dose-dependent biomarkers of propofol anesthesia
items.abstract: Understanding how receptor-level modulation reorganizes large-scale brain circuits remains a central challenge in neuropharmacology. Here we introduce a multiscale mechanistic model with explicit core-matrix thalamocortical architecture to examine how propofol reorganizes brainwide activity from individual receptors to systems-level circuits. Crucially, the model did not involve machine learning or statistical fitting to pre-existing anesthesia data. We use the model to simulate the multi-scale effects of propofol, which range from modulation of individual synaptic conductances to widespread alterations of neural spiking, field potentials, and coherence. Without requiring any training on task-specific data, our simulation of sensory processing in a standard auditory oddball paradigm matches independent data from anesthetized and awake behaving macaques. The same simulation, unmodified, also reproduces changes to functional connectivity in anesthetized humans, exhibiting selective attenuation of matrix thalamocortical loops relative to core loops. Most importantly, the simulation identified a previously unknown biomarker of propofol concentration: elevated residual inter-stimulus cortical activity. This dose-dependent biomarker was subsequently confirmed in empirical macaque data, where it had previously gone unnoticed. This simulation-first discovery, arising from mechanistic circuit dynamics rather than statistical comparison of clinical populations, serves as an illustrative example of a broader generative framework that can translate receptor-level modulation into circuit-scale biomarkers with potential applications across predictive neuropharmacology.
items.authors: Pathak, A.; Brincat, S. L.; Xiong, Y.; Organtzidis, H.; Protter, M.; Du, V.; Strey, H. H.; Mujica-Parodi, L. R.; Miller, E. K.; Granger, R.

items.title: Robust brain inspired prediction of speech recognition accuracy across many words, voices, and natural background sounds
items.abstract: Although humans generally excel at recognizing speech in noisy natural environments, performance varies widely due to differences in the background acoustics and individual talker attributes such as voice quality, intonation, and pitch. The underlying neural and acoustic factors of this perceptual variability remain elusive, making it an unresolved challenge to predict when speech recognition will succeed or fail. Here, we characterize human speech recognition across a wide range of natural conditions using speech spoken by 326 diverse male and female talkers of multiple ages embedded in 33 unique background noises. Across this vast soundscape, speech recognition is strongly driven by the spectrum and modulation statistics of the noise. Yet, articulatory speech features - including fundamental and formant frequencies - exert categorically distinct modulatory effects on recognition accuracy across the talkers age and gender, and specific words. This perceptual variability is captured by a low-dimensional statistical representation of sounds based on computations that emulate intermediate stages of sound processing and feature extraction in auditory midbrain. A model utilizing these sound summary statistics accurately predicts individual listeners single-trial recognition behavior, accounting for performance variance across individual voices, words, and backgrounds. Thus, speech-in-noise perception across diverse natural conditions relies largely on a simple set of spectrotemporal summary statistics known to be represented by central neural populations. Significance StatementAlthough humans can easily maintain conversations amidst environmental noise and voice variations, this capacity is severely degraded by hearing impairment and challenges modern speech recognition technologies. This study evaluates human speech recognition across a broad spectrum of environmental noises and diverse speaker demographics. We show that a brain-inspired auditory representation of sounds extracts critical statistical sound features driving human behavior, precisely predicting variations in perceptual accuracy across distinct voices, words, and environmental backgrounds.
items.authors: Clonan, A. C.; Stevenson, I. H.; Escabi, M. A.

items.title: Tolerance to Lung Infection in TWIK2 K+ Efflux Mediated Macrophage Trained Immunity
items.abstract: Alveolar macrophages (AM{phi}) are essential for innate immune function in the lungs. It is now apparent that macrophages can be trained to become better at attacking infections. Although trained immunity is thought to result from metabolic and epigenetic reprogramming, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we report that AM{phi} can be trained by extracellular ATP, which is ubiquitously released during inflammation. ATP ligates the canonical Purinergic Receptor 2 subtype X7 receptor (P2X7) to mediate endosomal Two-pore domain Weak Inwardly rectifying K+ channel 2 (TWIK2) translocation into the plasma membrane (PM). This endows the cells to transit to a ready state for microbial killing in two directions: first, K+ efflux via PM-TWIK2 induces NLRP3 inflammasome activation, which further activates metabolic pathways; second, upon bacterial phagocytosis, PM-TWIK2 internalizes into phagosome membrane with proper topological orientation, where TWIK2 mediates K+ influx into phagosomes to control pH and ionic strength favoring bacterial killing. Therefore, the enhanced association of TWIK2 in phagosomal and plasma membranes signaled by danger-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), such as ATP, mediates trained immunity in AM{phi} and enhances the microbiocidal activity.
items.authors: Thompson, J.; Li, Y.; Song, Y.; Kim, K.-W.; Malik, A.; Xu, J.
items.title_zh: TWIK2 K+外流介导的巨噬细胞训练免疫对肺部感染的耐受性
items.summary_zh: 肺泡巨噬细胞（AM{phi}）在肺部的先天免疫功能中至关重要。研究表明，巨噬细胞可以通过训练提高对感染的攻击能力。虽然训练免疫被认为是由代谢和表观遗传重编程引起的，但其机制尚不清楚。我们发现，AM{phi}可以通过细胞外ATP进行训练，ATP在炎症过程中普遍释放。ATP结合经典的嘌呤能受体2亚型P2X7，介导内源性双孔域弱内向整流K+通道2（TWIK2）转位至质膜（PM）。这使细胞能够在两个方向上进入微生物杀灭的准备状态：首先，PM-TWIK2介导的K+外流诱导NLRP3炎症小体激活，进一步激活代谢通路；其次，在细菌吞噬过程中，PM-TWIK2以适当的拓扑方向内化至吞噬体膜，TWIK2介导K+内流以控制pH和离子强度，从而有利于细菌杀灭。因此，TWIK2在吞噬体和质膜中的增强关联，受到危险相关分子模式（DAMPs）如ATP的信号调控，介导AM{phi}的训练免疫并增强其微生物杀灭活性。
items.l1_lead: TWIK2通道通过细胞外ATP信号调控巨噬细胞的训练免疫，增强其对肺部感染的耐受性和微生物杀灭能力。
items.l2_summary:
肺泡巨噬细胞（AMφ）在肺部的先天免疫功能中发挥着重要作用。近期研究发现，巨噬细胞能够通过“训练”来增强对感染的抵抗能力，这一过程被称为训练免疫。尽管训练免疫的代谢和表观遗传重编程机制已被提出，但具体的机制仍不明确。研究表明，AMφ可以通过细胞外ATP进行训练，ATP在炎症过程中被广泛释放，并通过与经典的嘌呤能受体2亚型P2X7结合，促进内源性双孔域弱内向整流K+通道2（TWIK2）转位至质膜（PM）。这一转位使得巨噬细胞能够在两个方向上准备好对微生物的杀灭。

首先，质膜TWIK2介导的K+外流能够诱导NLRP3炎症小体的激活，进一步激活相关的代谢通路，从而增强细胞的免疫反应。其次，在细菌吞噬过程中，质膜TWIK2会以适当的拓扑方向内化至吞噬体膜，TWIK2通过介导K+内流来调控吞噬体内的pH和离子强度，这一过程有助于细菌的有效杀灭。因此，TWIK2在吞噬体和质膜中的增强关联受到危险相关分子模式（DAMPs）如ATP的信号调控，进而介导AMφ的训练免疫，显著增强其微生物杀灭活性。这些发现为理解巨噬细胞的训练免疫机制提供了新的视角，并为未来针对肺部感染的免疫治疗策略奠定了基础。

items.title: Manganese scavenging is required for virulence of the cytosolic pathogen Listeria monocytogenes
items.abstract: Metals are essential for all forms of life and are therefore the subject of tight competition at the host-pathogen interface. Manganese (Mn) is an important cofactor for enzymes involved in various processes in bacteria, including the response to oxidative stress, and the ability to scavenge Mn through the expression of high-affinity Mn transporters has been associated with virulence of many extracellular and vacuolar pathogens. While the cytosol has been established to be restrictive for growth of non-adapted pathogens, the extent to which metal limitation contributes to this is not well understood. Here, we investigate whether high-affinity Mn acquisition is important for intracellular adaptation and virulence of the cytosolic pathogen Listeria monocytogenes (Lmo). To do so, we generated a strain of Lmo in which both of its predicted high-affinity Mn transporters, MntH and MntABC, are disrupted. We found that this strain was severely defective in growth in vitro under Mn-limited conditions and had lower intracellular Mn content. Additionally, we observed Mn-dependent transcriptional regulation of the mntH and mntA genes. Together, these data strongly support that MntH and MntABC are high-affinity Mn transporters and are likely to be the only such dedicated Mn transporters expressed in Lmo. Using the {Delta}mntH {Delta}mntA strain, we provide evidence that Mn limitation sensitizes Lmo to oxidative stress in vitro, consistent with the known role of Mn in mitigating reactive oxygen species. Ultimately, we demonstrate that expression of high-affinity Mn transporters is essential for intracellular replication of Lmo in macrophages, plaquing on fibroblast monolayers, and for virulence in an animal model of systemic infection. Our work, therefore, suggests that Lmo is challenged by Mn limitation in the cytosol and requires Mn scavenging to adapt to its intracellular niche.
items.authors: Mascari, C. A. M.; Carerros, C.; Kelliher, J. L.

items.title: An ancestral tRNA maturation enzyme repurposed for cytoplasmic non-coding RNA processing
items.abstract: Ribonuclease Z enzymes remove 3' trailers from precursor tRNAs. In human cells, ELAC2/RNase ZL matures nuclear and mitochondrial pre-tRNAs, whereas the cytosolic short paralog ELAC1/RNase ZS repairs ANKZF1-cleaved tRNAs, but its broader substrate repertoire remains unclear. We investigated ELAC1 function using transcriptome profiling, small RNA sequencing, CLIP-seq, and biochemical reconstitution. ELAC1 was dispensable for canonical tRNA processing but associated with structured RNA polymerase III transcripts, prominently Y RNAs and vault RNAs (vtRNAs). Purified ELAC1 cleaved all four human vtRNAs near their 3' ends, with high-resolution mapping identifying a conserved cleavage position within the 3' extension. Efficient cleavage required structural features of the vtRNA terminal region. In contrast, ELAC2 showed little or no vtRNA cleavage under the conditions tested and displayed stricter substrate and cleavage-site selection on pre-tRNA. Loss and re-expression of ELAC1 altered structured ncRNA abundance and small-RNA end profiles. These findings identify vtRNAs as direct ELAC1 substrates and support functional specialization of human ELAC paralogs, with ELAC2 favoring precise pre-tRNA maturation and ELAC1 exhibiting broader RNA substrate specificity.
items.authors: Shaukat, A.-N.; Dondeti, M. F.; Maniatis, A.; Skeparnias, I.; Kaliatsi, E. G.; Anastasakis, D. G.; Zhang, J.; Vourekas, A.; Stathopoulos, C.
items.title_zh: 祖先tRNA成熟酶在细胞质非编码RNA处理中的再利用
items.summary_zh: 核糖核酸酶Z酶去除前体tRNA的3'尾部。在人类细胞中，ELAC2/RNase ZL负责成熟核和线粒体前tRNA，而细胞质中的短同源物ELAC1/RNase ZS修复ANKZF1切割的tRNA，但其更广泛的底物谱尚不清楚。我们通过转录组分析、小RNA测序、CLIP-seq和生化重构研究了ELAC1的功能。结果显示，ELAC1对经典tRNA处理并非必需，但与结构化的RNA聚合酶III转录物相关，尤其是Y RNA和vault RNA（vtRNA）。纯化的ELAC1在所有四种人类vtRNA的3'末端附近切割，且高分辨率测序确定了保守的切割位点。有效切割需要vtRNA末端区域的结构特征。相比之下，ELAC2在测试条件下几乎不切割vtRNA，并对前tRNA表现出更严格的底物和切割位点选择。ELAC1的缺失和重新表达改变了结构化非编码RNA的丰度和小RNA末端谱。这些发现确认vtRNA是ELAC1的直接底物，并支持人类ELAC同源物的功能专业化，ELAC2偏向于精确的前tRNA成熟，而ELAC1则表现出更广泛的RNA底物特异性。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，ELAC1酶在细胞质中主要处理结构化非编码RNA，如Y RNA和vault RNA，而ELAC2则专注于前tRNA的成熟，显示出两者在功能上的专业化。
items.l2_summary:
研究表明，祖先tRNA成熟酶ELAC1（RNase ZS）在细胞质中不仅参与tRNA的处理，还对其他非编码RNA（ncRNA）具有重要的功能。ELAC1主要负责处理结构化的RNA聚合酶III转录物，特别是Y RNA和vault RNA（vtRNA）。通过转录组分析、小RNA测序、CLIP-seq和生化重构等方法，研究发现ELAC1对经典tRNA的处理并非必需，但在vtRNA的3'末端附近进行切割，且高分辨率测序确定了保守的切割位点。有效的切割需要vtRNA末端区域的特定结构特征，这表明ELAC1在处理这些RNA时具有特定的底物选择性。

相较之下，ELAC2（RNase ZL）在相同条件下几乎不切割vtRNA，并对前tRNA表现出更严格的底物和切割位点选择。这一发现强调了ELAC同源物在功能上的专业化，ELAC2更倾向于精确的前tRNA成熟，而ELAC1则展现出更广泛的RNA底物特异性。研究还发现，ELAC1的缺失和重新表达会显著改变结构化非编码RNA的丰度和小RNA末端谱，进一步支持了ELAC1作为vtRNA直接底物的角色。

综上所述，ELAC1在细胞质中不仅参与tRNA的成熟，还在处理vtRNA等结构化非编码RNA中发挥重要作用，揭示了其在RNA处理中的多样性和复杂性。这些结果为理解人类ELAC同源物的功能提供了新的视角，强调了其在RNA生物学中的潜在重要性。

items.title: Perturbation of the replication stress-ATR axis accelerates human erythroid differentiation but blocks terminal maturation
items.abstract: Replication stress (RS) can act as an input to differentiation: in erythroid and myeloid cells it is sufficient to accelerate commitment. Yet genotoxic chemotherapy, which imposes replication stress on the bone marrow can cause anemia; a frequent dose-limiting toxicity whose deficit of mature red cells is often attributed to progenitor depletion rather than to any effect on differentiation itself. Here, we ask how RS-induced accelerated commitment gives rise to impaired red cell output, using in vitro erythroid differentiation of cord-blood CD34+ progenitors perturbed with clinically relevant chemotherapy agents. We find that treated erythroblasts differentiate faster than controls but fail to mature, measured by lack of enucleated cells. Inhibition of ATR, but not ATM or DNA-PK, reproduces this phenotype. Mechanistically, single-cell profiling of drug-treated cells shows convergence on a transcriptional program, marked by loss of MYB and MYC activity. Treated cultures also accumulate aberrant late erythroblasts depleted for globin and heme programs and enriched for p53 and proteotoxic stress signatures. Together, these results propose that defective maturation is an alternative mechanism for chemotherapy-induced anemia, in addition to depletion of progenitors.
items.authors: Jauregui-Lozano, J.; Kremer, A.; Prummel, K. D.; Zaugg, J. B.

items.title: Fine-mapping HLA-II haplotypes in Alzheimer's disease and healthy longevity reveals distinct associations with microglial HLA-II load and neuropathology
items.abstract: Human leukocyte antigen (HLA) class II variation is implicated in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and longevity, but its mechanisms within the major histocompatibility complex remain unclear. We fine-mapped seven independent HLA-II haplotypes in 6,053 individuals (443 cognitively healthy centenarians [CHCs], 3,219 population controls, 2,391 AD patients). Three haplotypes overlapped previous AD and lifespan signals. Hap-B (DRB1*04subtypes) was protective, enriched in CHCs and controls versus AD, with its neuroprotective association with tau pathology replicated in an independent Netherlands Brain Bank cohort. Hap-R (DRB1*01:01) increased AD risk and reduced healthy longevity, with reduced microglial HLA-II activation. Hap-Y (DRB1*15:01) showed increased microglial HLA-II activation in post-mortem brain tissue, independent of quantitative AD neuropathology. These findings indicate distinct HLA-II haplotypes shape AD susceptibility and healthy longevity through separate mechanisms, linking HLA architecture to brain immune states beyond classical neuropathology.
items.authors: Alvarez Sirvent, D.; Luimes, M. C.; Tesi, N.; Rohde, S. K.; Salazar, A. N.; Bijker, L. J.; van Schoor, N. M.; Tijms, B. M.; Vijverberg, E. G. B.; Strijbis, E. M. M.; Hoekstra, E. J.; The Netherlands Brain Bank,  ; Holtman, I. R.; van der Lee, S. J.; Hulsman, M.; Holstege, H.

items.title: Machine Learning-Supported Efficient VTE Risk Assessment using Routinely Collected Electronic Health Record Data
items.abstract: Objective: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a leading cause of preventable inpatient mortality, while the real-world performance of mandated risk assessment and the potential for automating using electronic health record (EHR) data remain unclear. We evaluated completion, concordance with structured EHR data, clinical validity, and feasibility of EHR-supported VTE risk assessment assisted by machine learning. Materials and Methods: We analysed 577,904 admissions and 726,896 VTE assessment forms across five NHS hospitals between 2015 and 2025. Concordance and clinical validity were evaluated in 87,118 completed assessments from 2023 to 2024. Machine learning models compared clinician-recorded and EHR-derived risk factors in 74,372 encounters with an assessment completed within 14 hours of admission. Results: Overall completion was 96.7%, and timely completion improved from 47.4% in 2015 to 90.5% in 2024. Agreement between forms and EHR data was good for common risk factors (e.g. age over 60 years: precision 0.95, recall 0.77), but low-prevalence variables were often under-documented in the forms (e.g. critical care admission: precision 0.20, recall 0.14). Despite these discrepancies, form-derived thrombosis risk was associated with increased VTE incidence (adjusted OR 3.31, 95% CI 2.81-3.90). Models using EHR-derived factors available within 14 hours achieved an AUROC of 0.709, compared with 0.704 for clinician-recorded variables. Discussion: Much of the information the risk assessment requires already exists in structured EHR data, and EHR-derived variables contained discriminative information comparable to that in clinician-recorded factors. Conclusion: Routinely collected EHR data could support real-time pre-population of structured VTE assessments, thereby reducing documentation burden while preserving clinical validity.
items.authors: Li, Z.; Yagis, E.; Riad, A.; Windrath-Carr, O.; Arribas, M.; Sodiq, T.; Goldsmith, K.; Glampson, B.; Flott, K.; Haji, G.; Khan, Z.; Baker, C.; Mayer, E. K.

items.title: HPV binding antibodies are associated with protection: a meta-analysis
items.abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the major cause of cervical cancer globally. Current vaccines have shown high efficacy at preventing HPV infection and other surrogate disease endpoints in randomised controlled trials (RCT). However, uptake is limited by accessibility and cost. Rapid clinical evaluation is critical for shortening time-to-market and encouraging the development and deployment of affordable vaccines. We aim to establish a validated correlate of protection that will support vaccine developers and decision makers with vaccine development, approval, dose schedules and deployment decisions. Methods: We utilised three existing Cochrane Systematic Reviews of RCTs of HPV vaccines and extended these to 1st January 2026. We identified and extracted data from trials where both efficacy and immunogenicity (HPV-specific antibodies) were reported. For HPV types where vaccine efficacy was reported but not immunogenicity (Types 31/33/45/52/58) we sourced antibody binding concentrations from separate immunogenicity studies. We linked antibody binding concentrations from each RCT to the corresponding vaccine efficacy data, matching by study, vaccine arm, number of doses, and HPV type. We use a Bayesian framework in a model-based meta-analysis to examine the association between antibody binding concentrations and vaccine efficacy. Findings: Combining data on both vaccine-targeted and non-targeted HPV types, we find an association between type-specific antibody binding concentrations and vaccine efficacy against the three HPV outcomes tested: incident infection, persistent infection and grade 2 or 3 cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN2+) (p<0.0005, for all outcomes). We also compared this association with data from studies of natural infection, which had shown an association between antibody binding concentrations and risk of infection. This demonstrated that the association between vaccine-induced antibodies and vaccine efficacy was well aligned with the existing HPV literature on correlates of risk from natural exposure. Finally, we find evidence that the antibody concentrations associated with 50% (of the maximal) vaccine efficacy differ by type (p<0.0005, for example 16 sIU/ml for HPV58, but <0.5 IU/ml for HPV 16/18). Interpretations: HPV type-specific antibody binding concentrations are associated with protection against HPV related clinical outcomes, across different HPV types and vaccines, and after natural infection. The consistent observation that antibody binding concentrations correlate with protection provides support for the use of antibody binding for immunobridging, for example in non-inferiority studies when assessing similar vaccines. Funding: This work is supported by National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia and the University of New South Wales.
items.authors: Berry, M. T.; Palmer, M. R.; Khan, S. R.; Bowden-Reid, E.; Egilmezer, E.; Smith, M. A.; Bateson, D.; Canfell, K.; Davenport, M. P.; Khoury, D. S.
items.title_zh: HPV结合抗体与保护相关性：一项荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）是全球宫颈癌的主要致病因素。现有疫苗在随机对照试验中显示出预防HPV感染及其他替代疾病终点的高效性，但因可及性和成本限制，接种率较低。快速的临床评估对缩短上市时间和促进经济疫苗的开发至关重要。我们旨在建立一个经过验证的保护相关性，以支持疫苗开发者和决策者在疫苗开发、批准、剂量安排和部署决策方面。方法：我们利用了三项现有的Cochrane系统评价，并将其扩展至2026年1月1日。我们提取了同时报告有效性和免疫原性（HPV特异性抗体）的试验数据。对于报告了疫苗有效性但未报告免疫原性的HPV类型（31/33/45/52/58），我们从单独的免疫原性研究中获取了抗体结合浓度。我们将每个RCT的抗体结合浓度与相应的疫苗有效性数据关联。我们使用贝叶斯框架进行模型基础的荟萃分析，以考察抗体结合浓度与疫苗有效性之间的关联。发现：结合疫苗有效性和抗体结合浓度的数据。
items.l1_lead: HPV疫苗的抗体结合浓度与其有效性存在显著相关性，为疫苗开发和接种策略提供了重要的科学依据。
items.l2_summary:
人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）是导致全球宫颈癌的主要病因，现有疫苗在随机对照试验中显示出对HPV感染及相关疾病的高效预防能力。然而，由于疫苗的可及性和成本问题，接种率仍然较低。因此，快速的临床评估对于缩短疫苗上市时间和促进经济型疫苗的开发至关重要。本研究旨在建立经过验证的保护相关性，以支持疫苗开发者和决策者在疫苗开发、批准、剂量安排和部署决策方面的工作。

为此，研究团队利用了三项现有的Cochrane系统评价，并将其扩展至2026年1月1日，提取了同时报告疫苗有效性和免疫原性（HPV特异性抗体）的试验数据。对于那些报告了疫苗有效性但未报告免疫原性的HPV类型（如31、33、45、52、58），研究者从单独的免疫原性研究中获取了抗体结合浓度。通过将每个随机对照试验（RCT）的抗体结合浓度与相应的疫苗有效性数据进行关联，研究团队使用贝叶斯框架进行模型基础的荟萃分析，以考察抗体结合浓度与疫苗有效性之间的关系。

研究结果表明，抗体结合浓度与疫苗有效性之间存在显著的关联性，这为疫苗的保护相关性提供了重要的证据支持。这一发现不仅为疫苗的进一步开发提供了理论基础，也为公共卫生决策者在疫苗的推广和接种策略制定方面提供了重要参考。通过建立这种保护相关性，研究为提高HPV疫苗的接种率和有效性提供了新的思路，进而有助于降低宫颈癌的发病率。

items.title: Expression of specific var gene subtypes is associated with distinct severe malaria syndromes
items.abstract: The virulence of Plasmodium falciparum is closely linked to P. falciparum erythrocyte membrane protein 1 (PfEMP1), encoded by the diverse var gene family. PfEMP1 mediates parasite immune evasion and vascular adhesion of infected red blood cells, contributing to severe disease. While expression of group A or domain cassette (DC8 and DC13)-containing var genes have been associated with severe malaria, direct comparisons between the severe malaria syndromes remain limited. Furthermore, interactions between specific var gene expression and the rosetting phenotype, a known marker of severe malaria, are incompletely understood across severe malaria syndromes. We analysed parasite and clinical data from 966 Kenyan children with non-severe malaria and severe malaria syndromes collected over 18 years in Kilifi, Kenya. Var gene transcription was profiled using DBL-tag sequencing (n=898), RT-qPCR (n=768), and DBL-tag-based prediction tools. We show that parasites expressing group A or DC8 var genes were associated with impaired consciousness (IC), while rosetting was associated with respiratory distress (RD) and severe malarial anaemia (SMA), but not IC. Variant expression was more homogeneous in SMA than IC or RD. These findings suggest that IC, RD and SMA reflect distinct underlying parasite virulence strategies: sequestration, rosetting associated parasite virulence, and chronicity of infection respectively. In conclusion, this analysis provides the most comprehensive characterisation of P. falciparum var gene expression across the major severe malaria syndromes to date and highlights the possibility of syndrome-specific parasite virulence mechanisms that may inform the development of targeted therapeutic interventions
items.authors: Ndugwa, H.; Muthui, M.; Rowe, A.; Kinyanjui, S.; Andisi, C.; Abdi, A. I.

items.title: WITHDRAWN: How to Detect the Early Cardiac Functional Change and Predict Heart Failure in Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation? A Prospective Cohort Study
items.abstract: Backgrounds20-30% atrial fibrillation (AF) may result in heart failure (HF). Noninvasive left ventricle myocardial work (LVMW) is a fairly new method for detecting LV function. We aimed to evaluate whether LVMW could detect the LV change function in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF) and predict HF incident. MethodsIn this prospective cohort study, 146 PAF subjects and 63 non-PAF subjects matched by age and gender set as the controls were enrolled. Noninvasive LVMW parameters, including global work index, global constructive work, global wasted work (GWW) and global work efficiency (GWE) were obtained from LV pressure-strain loop by 2D speckle tracking imaging. LA volume index (LAVI) was measured by 3D echocardiography. AF burden (AFB) was evaluated by questionnaire. The primary outcome was the incident HF.AFB deterioration was evaluated at the end of follow up. Stata15.0 and R4.1 were used for data analysis and description. ResultsThe average age was 66.2{+/-}11.4 years and comprised 55% males in PAF. Compared with the controls, PAF had significantly elevated GWW (143.7{+/-}88.3mmHg% vs 115.5{+/-}59.6mmHg%, p<0.001) and impaired GWE (92.3{+/-}7.5% vs 93.8{+/-}2.8%, p=0.035) and they were correlated with increased LAVImax and LAVImin. Those with higher AFB showed significantly decreased LAEF and increased LAVImin. During the average 40.5 months follow-up, 9.9% PAF developed HF and ablation reduced the HF occurrence. In the non-ablation subgroup, baseline decreased LAEF rather than LVMW was a strong predictor for HF. As expected, AFB deterioration was strongly associated with HF incident. ConclusionsElevated GWW was detected by LVMW and it was strongly correlated with LA dilation in PAF. Higher AFB had adverse effect on LAVImin. Restoring sinus rhythm was significant for HF prevention, especially for PAF with lower LAEF. Clinical PerspectiveO_ST_ABSWhat is new?C_ST_ABSO_LIAlthough GLS and LVEF remained normal, subtle LV dysfunction of elevated GWW and impaired GWE could be detected by LVMW in the early stage of PAF. C_LIO_LIIncreased LAVImin, rather than LAEF, was strongly associated with elevated GWW and higher AF burden in PAF. C_LIO_LIRestoring sinus rhythm was important to early stage of PAF for HF prevention, especially in PAF with lower LAEF. C_LI What are the clinical implications?O_LIIt is significant for PAF to protect LV function by maintaining sinus rhythm or keeping AFB at minimal-mild stage, even from the very early stage. C_LIO_LIIncreased LAVImin is an important indicator for detecting LV dysfunction in PAF and the underlying mechanism needs to be discovered. C_LI
items.authors: Cheng, L.; bao, L.; Zhuang, X.; Yan, F.; Gao, X.; Zhou, P.; Zhao, Y.; Yang, K.; Zhang, Q.; Huang, G.; bao, L.

items.title: Agreement between an artificial intelligence video-analysis platform and human evaluators scoring emergency medical technician psychomotor skills: a fully crossed reliability study
items.abstract: BackgroundA primary constraint on the capacity of EMS programs to meet industry demand is psychomotor instruction and verification--requiring direct observation of each student by a qualified evaluator. Whether AI video analysis can relieve it is untested; none has been applied to EMS skill examination or compared with human examiners. ObjectiveTo quantify human EMS evaluator inter-rater reliability and evaluate an AI video-analysis platform against it. MethodsIn a prospective, fully crossed study, five certified EMS evaluators and an AI platform independently scored identical video-recorded EMT performances of cervical collar application (n=15), bag-valve-mask (BVM) ventilation (n=14), and medical assessment (n=15) on dichotomous checklists with critical-failure criteria. Agreement was assessed at item, score, and decision levels using Fleiss {kappa}, Krippendorffs , Gwets AC1, and ICC(2,1)/ICC(2,k). ResultsHuman item agreement was moderate ({kappa} 0.409-0.467), as was single-rater reliability (ICC(2,1) 0.539-0.694), against good panel reliability (ICC(2,k) 0.854-0.919). Recorded pass/fail agreement was fair ({kappa} 0.297-0.388) and critical-failure agreement near zero for two skills ({kappa} 0.028, 0.119). AI alignment tracked rubric observability rather than task complexity: r = 0.857 (collar, exceeding every human), -0.173 (BVM), 0.664 (medical), and it was most lenient on two skills. ConclusionsHuman evaluators are an imperfect standard, especially on critical failures. The AI was a legitimate additional rater where checklist items were discrete and visually verifiable, but not where credit required judging continuous quantities such as ventilation rate, volume, or suction duration. Defensible uses are formative and archival, not summative. These results reflect an early, non-specialist configuration--a baseline, not a limit.
items.authors: Otte, J. H.; Cartagena, A.

items.title: Prevalence of Enteric Hyperoxaluria in Crohn's Disease, Cystic Fibrosis, and After Bariatric Surgery: A Systematic Review
items.abstract: Abstract Background. Enteric hyperoxaluria (EH) causes calcium oxalate kidney stones, oxalate nephropathy, and chronic kidney disease (CKD), and can progress to end-stage kidney disease. It occurs in Crohn's disease (CD), cystic fibrosis (CF), chronic pancreatitis, celiac disease, short bowel syndrome, and after bariatric surgery. Its prevalence in these populations has not been synthesized. Methods. PROSPERO CRD420261364424. PubMed and Embase were searched to 24 August 2026 for studies reporting 24-hour urinary oxalate. Prevalence was pooled using the Freeman-Tukey double arcsine transformation with a DerSimonian-Laird random-effects model; unweighted crude prevalence is also reported. Because heterogeneity was high, the narrative synthesis stratified by testing condition is the primary result. Prespecified subgroups addressed oxalate load before collection, diagnostic threshold, ileal resection, age, and urine collection format. Results. Forty-seven studies were included. In CD (17 studies, 471 patients; 204 with EH), crude prevalence was 43.3% and pooled prevalence 49.3% (95% CI 38.9-59.8; I^2 = 95.3%). With an oxalate load, prevalence was 64.7% (pooled 74.0%, 55.9-88.6) versus 38.6% without (pooled 39.1%, 28.7-50.0). Among CD patients, EH was more frequent with ileal resection (48.8% vs 31.7%; OR 1.62, 0.91-2.89) and with steatorrhea (62.5% vs 29.3%; OR 9.88, 3.81-25.61). In CF (7 studies, 348 patients; 179 with EH), pooled prevalence was 49.8% (40.5-59.1; I^2 = 91.9%). After bariatric surgery (15 studies, 849 patients; 474 with EH), pooled prevalence was 54.7% (45.4-63.9; I^2 = 96.7%). Conclusions. Roughly half of these patients have EH, but the proportion depends heavily on whether an oxalate load precedes urine collection (39% unprovoked vs 65%-74% provoked); because most studies do not state this condition, published prevalence estimates are not directly comparable. Ileal resection and steatorrhea identify those who should be screened.
items.authors: Xing, X.; He, H.; Liu, H.; Li, Q.
items.title_zh: 克罗恩病、囊性纤维化及减重手术后肠源性高草酸尿症的流行病学研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：肠源性高草酸尿症（EH）可导致草酸钙肾结石、草酸盐肾病和慢性肾病（CKD），并可能进展为终末期肾病。它发生在克罗恩病（CD）、囊性纤维化（CF）、慢性胰腺炎、乳糜泻、短肠综合症及减重手术后。方法：通过PubMed和Embase检索至2026年8月24日，纳入报告24小时尿草酸的研究。使用Freeman-Tukey双反正弦变换和DerSimonian-Laird随机效应模型进行流行率汇总。结果：共纳入47项研究。在CD患者中（17项研究，471名患者；204名有EH），粗略流行率为43.3%，汇总流行率为49.3%（95% CI 38.9-59.8；I^2 = 95.3%）。有草酸负荷时，流行率为64.7%（汇总74.0%），而无草酸负荷时为38.6%（汇总39.1%）。在CD患者中，肠切除术和脂肪泻与EH的发生率增加相关。
items.l1_lead: 克罗恩病患者中，肠源性高草酸尿症的流行率高达49.3%，且与肠切除术和脂肪泻密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
肠源性高草酸尿症（EH）是一种可能导致草酸钙肾结石、草酸盐肾病及慢性肾病（CKD）的疾病，严重时可进展为终末期肾病。该病常见于克罗恩病（CD）、囊性纤维化（CF）、慢性胰腺炎、乳糜泻、短肠综合症以及减重手术后的患者。为探讨EH的流行病学特征，研究者通过PubMed和Embase数据库检索至2026年8月24日，纳入了报告24小时尿草酸的相关研究，共计47项研究被纳入分析。

在克罗恩病患者中，涉及17项研究，涵盖471名患者，其中204名被诊断为EH，粗略流行率为43.3%。经过汇总分析，克罗恩病患者的EH汇总流行率为49.3%（95% CI 38.9-59.8；I^2 = 95.3%），显示出该病在此类患者中的高发性。研究还发现，在进行草酸负荷测试时，EH的流行率显著增加，达到64.7%（汇总74.0%），而在未进行草酸负荷的情况下，流行率为38.6%（汇总39.1%）。此外，肠切除术和脂肪泻与EH的发生率增加存在相关性，这提示临床上需对这些患者进行更为细致的监测与管理。

综上所述，克罗恩病患者中肠源性高草酸尿症的流行率较高，尤其在经历草酸负荷测试后，流行率显著上升。肠切除术和脂肪泻可能是影响EH发生的重要因素，这为临床提供了重要的预防和干预线索。

items.title: Ecological momentary assessments predict clinical anxiety and depression status at 3 months post-stroke
items.abstract: Background: Stroke survivors frequently experience post-stroke depression (PSD) and post-stroke anxiety (PSA), which may be underexamined by clinicians if patient mood status between discharge and follow-up is unknown. Digital monitoring may enable early identification of mood disturbances. Ecological momentary assessments (EMA) have been tested to capture mood fluctuations in patients regular environments, but no standardized procedure for monitoring PSA or PSD has been developed. Objective: Determine the feasibility and validity of EMA for evaluating subacute PSA and PSD in non-severe stroke patients. Methods: Patients with non-severe stroke discharged home responded to daily smartphone EMA questions concerning mood and activity for twelve weeks until follow-up. Questions based on symptoms of anxiety and depression were used to derive EMA Anx and EMA Dep indices, computed over five 15-day intervals. Convergent validity was assessed using follow-up Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) and Centre for Epidemiological Studies-Depression (CES-D) scores. Logistic regression models predicted PSA and PSD status at follow-up, with baseline models comprising stroke severity, age, sex, and mood status, to which EMA Anx or Dep were added. Results: Data from 118 patients were analyzed. EMA adherence was moderate, with 89 patients (75.4%) responding on 75 or more days. Correlations between EMA Anx and GAD-7 and between EMA Dep and CES-D generally strengthened at later intervals, with the average mood index generally showing the strongest associations. Adding EMA data from the third time interval (31-45 days) significantly improved model fit beyond the baseline models (Anxiety: {chi}-square = 7.08, p = 0.008, {delta}R-square = 0.060; Depression: {chi}-square = 28.0, p < 0.001, {delta}R-square = 0.256). Discussion: EMA is feasible in mild-to-moderate stroke patients and may facilitate early identification of post-stroke mood disturbances. Further analyses in more diverse populations are required to validate these findings.
items.authors: Duttagupta, S.; Berthoz, S.; Sibon, I.
items.title_zh: 生态瞬时评估预测中风后3个月的焦虑和抑郁状态
items.summary_zh: 背景：中风幸存者常经历中风后抑郁（PSD）和中风后焦虑（PSA），若患者在出院与随访之间的情绪状态未知，临床医生可能会忽视这些问题。数字监测有助于早期识别情绪障碍。生态瞬时评估（EMA）已被测试用于捕捉患者在日常环境中的情绪波动，但尚未制定标准化的PSD或PSA监测程序。目的：确定EMA在评估非严重中风患者亚急性PSA和PSD的可行性和有效性。方法：非严重中风患者在出院后接受为期12周的每日智能手机EMA问卷，内容涉及情绪和活动。根据焦虑和抑郁症状构建EMA Anx和EMA Dep指数，计算五个15天的时间段。使用随访的广泛性焦虑障碍-7（GAD-7）和流行病学研究中心抑郁量表（CES-D）评分评估收敛效度。结果：分析了118名患者的数据，EMA遵从率中等，89名患者（75.4%）在75天或以上作答。
items.l1_lead: 生态瞬时评估（EMA）在评估中风后患者的焦虑和抑郁状态方面显示出可行性和有效性，为早期识别情绪障碍提供了新的监测手段。
items.l2_summary:
中风幸存者常常面临中风后抑郁（PSD）和中风后焦虑（PSA）的问题，而在患者出院与随访之间的情绪状态往往难以掌握，这可能导致临床医生忽视这些情绪障碍。为了解决这一问题，数字监测技术的应用显得尤为重要，能够帮助早期识别情绪问题。生态瞬时评估（EMA）作为一种新兴的评估工具，已被用于捕捉患者在日常生活中的情绪波动，但目前尚未建立标准化的PSD或PSA监测程序。因此，本研究旨在探讨EMA在评估非严重中风患者亚急性PSA和PSD的可行性和有效性。

研究对象为118名非严重中风患者，他们在出院后接受了为期12周的每日智能手机EMA问卷，问卷内容涉及患者的情绪和活动。研究通过构建EMA Anx（焦虑指数）和EMA Dep（抑郁指数）来评估患者的情绪状态，并计算了五个15天的时间段。为了验证EMA的收敛效度，研究还使用了广泛性焦虑障碍-7（GAD-7）和流行病学研究中心抑郁量表（CES-D）进行随访评估。

结果显示，118名患者的数据分析表明，EMA的遵从率为中等，其中89名患者（75.4%）在75天或以上参与了问卷作答。这一结果表明，EMA在监测中风后患者的情绪状态方面具有一定的可行性和有效性，为临床提供了新的情绪评估工具。通过这种数字化的监测方式，能够更好地识别和管理中风后患者的焦虑和抑郁问题，从而改善他们的生活质量。

items.title: Navigating Life After Dementia Diagnosis: Questions, Challenges, and Support Needs Among Dementia Dyads
items.abstract: Background: Older adults living with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (AD/ADRD) and their care partners face substantial daily challenges that evolve with disease progression and extend far beyond the clinical setting, including symptom management, care coordination, healthcare navigation, and planning for future care needs. Understanding these challenges is essential for developing innovative solutions to provide ongoing and targeted support. In this study, we explored questions, challenges, and support needs experienced by dementia dyads following diagnosis to inform the development of an artificial intelligence (AI)-based chatbot designed to provide ongoing support for dementia dyads. Methods: We recruited 11 community-dwelling dyads comprising persons living with MCI or mild AD/ADRD and their care partners, one additional care partner, and 12 dementia care experts from academic medical centers, clinics, and aging organizations in the U.S. We conducted semi-structured interviews and analyzed them using conventional content analysis. Results: Participants described interconnected questions, challenges, and support needs that evolved while navigating life with MCI or AD/ADRD. Questions centered around day-to-day care management, medical concerns, behavioral symptom management, diagnosis and prognosis, safety, and resources and services. Challenges included care partner overwhelm, limited dementia knowledge, condition-related uncertainty, healthcare system navigation difficulties, financial constraints, and technology-related barriers. Participants identified needs for ongoing education, personalized care planning, resource navigation, logistical support and follow-up, culturally responsive care, and social and emotional support. Conclusions: Dementia dyads experience substantial informational, emotional, and practical support needs in the early stages of MCI and AD/ADRD. Findings suggest that post-diagnostic support should extend beyond information provision alone to provide ongoing, personalized, and practical guidance that helps dyads navigate changing needs, resources, and everyday dementia care. These findings are informing the development of an AI-based chatbot intended to complement existing dementia care by extending access to education, practical guidance, and resource navigation between clinical encounters.
items.authors: Britt, K.; Harb, A.; Bailey, B.; Saffold, B.; Luo, X.; Brown, R. T.; Huang, B.
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病诊断后的生活导航：问题、挑战与支持需求
items.summary_zh: 背景：生活在轻度认知障碍（MCI）或阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（AD/ADRD）中的老年人及其照护伙伴面临着随着疾病进展而变化的重大日常挑战，这些挑战超出了临床环境，包括症状管理、护理协调、医疗导航和未来护理需求的规划。本研究探讨了痴呆二人组在诊断后所经历的问题、挑战和支持需求，以为开发基于人工智能（AI）的聊天机器人提供持续支持提供信息。方法：我们招募了11对社区居住的二人组，包括生活在MCI或轻度AD/ADRD中的人及其照护伙伴，另外一名照护伙伴，以及来自美国学术医疗中心、诊所和老龄化组织的12名痴呆护理专家。我们进行了半结构化访谈，并采用传统内容分析法进行分析。结果：参与者描述了在应对MCI或AD/ADRD生活时相互关联的问题、挑战和支持需求，这些问题主要集中在日常护理管理、医疗关注、行为症状管理、诊断与预后、安全性以及资源和服务等方面。
items.l1_lead: 老年痴呆患者及其照护者在生活中面临多重挑战，亟需针对日常护理和医疗支持的有效解决方案，以应对疾病进展带来的影响。
items.l2_summary:
阿尔茨海默病（AD）及相关痴呆（ADRD）患者及其照护伙伴在面对轻度认知障碍（MCI）或阿尔茨海默病的生活时，经历了许多日常挑战，这些挑战随着疾病的进展而不断变化，超出了传统临床环境的范畴。为了深入了解这些挑战及其支持需求，本研究招募了11对生活在社区中的二人组，包括MCI或轻度AD/ADRD患者及其照护伙伴，此外还邀请了来自美国学术医疗中心、诊所和老龄化组织的12名痴呆护理专家。研究采用半结构化访谈的方式，并通过传统内容分析法进行数据分析。

参与者在访谈中描述了在应对MCI或AD/ADRD生活时所面临的相互关联的问题和挑战，主要集中在多个方面，包括日常护理管理、医疗关注、行为症状管理、诊断与预后、安全性以及资源和服务的获取等。具体而言，患者和照护伙伴在日常护理管理中常常感到无助，尤其是在如何有效管理症状和协调医疗服务方面。此外，行为症状的管理也是一个重要的挑战，患者的行为变化可能会给照护伙伴带来额外的压力和困扰。

在医疗关注方面，参与者反映出对医疗系统的导航存在困难，尤其是在获取适当的医疗资源和服务时，缺乏明确的指导和支持。安全性问题同样引起了参与者的广泛关注，患者的认知能力下降使得他们在日常生活中面临更高的风险，这进一步加重了照护伙伴的负担。

通过本研究的发现，可以看出，MCI和AD/ADRD患者及其照护伙伴在生活中面临的挑战是多方面的，亟需针对这些问题提供更为系统和持续的支持。这些信息为开发基于人工智能（AI）的聊天机器人提供了重要的基础，旨在为患者和照护伙伴提供更有效的支持和指导，以帮助他们更好地应对日常生活中的挑战。总之，针对痴呆患者及其照护者的支持需求的深入理解，将有助于改善他们的生活质量，并为未来的护理规划提供重要参考。

items.title: Learning-by-Doing to Adapt a Digital Community Engagement Strategy for Identifying and Reaching Zero-Dose Children in Kano State, Nigeria: A Program Case Study
items.abstract: Background: Kano State has one of the highest concentrations of zero-dose (ZD) children in Nigeria, challenging equitable immunization coverage. Digital engagement tools meant to strengthen timely data to address such gaps often underperform due to limited adaptability to user needs. Learning-by-doing (LxD), which brings together human-centered design and adaptive management, offers more context-responsive solutions. Intervention and Implementation Approach: MCH-Track, a digital platform for tracking and referral for childhood vaccinations was used by 56 female community mobilizers in two local government areas (LGAs) out of the 44 LGAs in Kano State, Nigeria. We conducted a program case study from: 1) August 2024-April 2025 (initial implementation); and 2) adapted implementation (May 2025-November 2025), where LxD was incorporated to address emergent challenges. LxD included structured shadowing, monthly interviews with users, after-action reviews, and change log to track adaptations alongside routine services. Performance was monitored using four indicators: feedback actioned, response time-to-user feedback, ease-of-use score, and mobilizer performance in tracking ZD children. Findings: After incorporating LxD, 17 issues were identified and led to 12 prioritized adaptations. All logged issues received responses, with median response time declining to approximately two weeks, while community mobilizers reported higher usability of the digital platform (e.g., mean ease-of-use score of 4.1 out of 5). Enhanced root-cause analysis enabled trend tracking and clearer escalation pathways for systemic issues like micro-stockouts at immunization points.
